rows: ||Three pages of story missions, one of optional errands||
||Two pages of story missions, one of the four side jobs opened by Coffee Break||
||Four pages, the last two built around The Cartel Heist||
||One page; guides had not yet published walkthroughs||
||One page per contact: Shirley, Cal and Kenton, Kirk, Kyle, Moses, Bret Vogel, Billy, Yago, Andy, Yasmani, Randy, Tyrone, Dunk, Eddie Acosta, Pilot Pete||
||Everything mission-related that counts, in one list||

items: ||Which contacts count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy. PowerPyx confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, and says Shirley, Cal, Moses, Billy, Andy, Yasmani, Tyrone and Eddie Acosta do not. It does not say for Kenton, Bret Vogel, Randy or Dunk.||
||Mission totals. PowerPyx and GTABase number the story differently, so the counts on each page follow PowerPyx's walkthrough list.||

blocks.text: Prologue and
The first ten missions, from the prison opening to Jason settling into his house in Key Lento. Most are short and teach one system each.

blocks.caption: ||Gear Up: Jason at the counter of a gun shop, rifles on the wall behind the clerk.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Gear Up | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Lucia in the Prologue, Jason from Gone Fishing||
||Jason's house in Key Lento, given by Gone Fishing||
||Cash in a trailer in Gone Fishing; the Macizo Cigar in Pipework||

blocks.title: Prologue
blocks.text: ||Given by Lucia at Hamlet Prison. Talk to your cellmates, follow CO Wilson to the counsellor's office, then play the flashback: threaten the teller at the Payday Loan shop and grab the cash. The police chase cannot be escaped; the game returns you to the office on its own. No reward.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia in an orange jumpsuit walking into the prison common room

blocks.title: Gone Fishing
blocks.text: ||Starts straight after the Prologue, as Jason with Cal. Drive beside the plane so Cal can fish out the packages, scout the docks with binoculars, then search the camp and free Donnie from the shack, and fly the seaplane back to Brian's Marina. Reward: Jason's house in Key Lento. Full stealth earns Professional standing. Missable: cash in the white and red trailer on the left, on the way to the plane.||

blocks.title: Gear Up (Pick Up Another Gun)
blocks.text: ||Opens after Gone Fishing. Walk into the Ammu-Nation near Jason's house and buy a longarm from Andrew: a shotgun or a tactical rifle, though you can likely afford only the shotgun. Three Kingfishers then shoot at you outside. Reward: the longarm you chose.||

blocks.title: Lab Fees (Collect Brian's Rent)
blocks.text: ||Opens after Gone Fishing. Call Brian to open the boutique, talk to the clerk and punch him once; he offers acid instead. The lab keypad code is 0420. Take the acid to Brian's lockup, code 7700, and leave it in the stash. Reward: $600, sent to the mailbox outside Jason's house.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason facing the clerk in a cluttered boutique

blocks.title: Just a Scratch (Fix Your Car)
blocks.text: ||Opens after Gone Fishing. Drive Jason's '70 Ganado to Joey, talk to him and drive into the garage. Pick Full Engine for the free repair, then Cosmetics, Respray, in any colour. Reward: a free engine repair and respray; mod shops and Pay 'n' Spray open up.||
blocks.frameAlt: A blue pickup in Joey's garage bay

blocks.title: Unwanted Attention (Go See Cal)
blocks.text: ||Meet Cal on the beach in north Key Lento. At the Hamlet impound, climb the fence and the containers in the back corner, unhook the red Phoenix from the tow car and drive out when the gate opens. Lose the police, respray at the Hamlet Pay 'n' Spray, park in Brian's garage and take $150 from the back room. Reward: the police scanner and $150. GTABase adds a lift at the back of the lot that leads to the roof.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason walking past a tow truck and a red car at the impound

blocks.title: Pipework (Collect Mandy's Rent)
blocks.text: ||Needs Gear Up, Lab Fees, Just a Scratch and Unwanted Attention. Talk to Mandy outside her house, follow her in, take the plunger from the bathroom floor and fix the kitchen sink. Missable: a Macizo Cigar she throws into the street, which must be picked up there.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason with a backpack outside a pale blue house

blocks.title: Hey Arnold! (Meet Brian)
blocks.text: ||Brian calls a few minutes after Pipework; meet him at the pool bar in the south of Key Lento. Pick up Cal at the liquor store, find Arnold near the radar station in Maroon Key and chase him to the docks while bikers shoot from motorcycles. The choice at the docks changes nothing that follows.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason meeting a man at a waterside bar table

blocks.title: Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)
blocks.text: ||Talk to Kenton at his Island Dreams shop by the beach. Take the boat to the dive spot, put on the yellow scuba gear, swim through the trench to the wreck and use the Metal Detector until its light turns green; collect all 3 treasures. Lift the grate, then use the Arras Bullhead harpoon on the shark. Reward: $400.||
blocks.frameAlt: A diver swimming over a reef full of sea urchins

blocks.title: Feng Shui (Meet Cal)
blocks.text: ||Starts when you enter Jason's house after Island Dreams. Grab a beer, sit with Cal and help him move the TV, coffee table, couch and chair. Then play Tenebrae Lux and Street Trash III; neither can be won, and both end by themselves. No reward. After this, Lucia's errands and Cal's fishing challenge appear.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason and Cal on a couch with beers

pages.title: Chapter 1: Coming Home to Building a Life

blocks.text: Chapter 1,
Lucia comes home, the bank account opens and Brian's jobs move up a gear. Several of these are short steps done from the phone.

blocks.caption: ||Coming Home: Jason on his phone among red flowers, in a cap and grey vest.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Coming Home | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Do Lucia's five errands and the house repairs if you want the best start to the relationship||

blocks.title: Coming Home (Lucia's Release)
blocks.text: ||Opens after Feng Shui. Sleep at the house until Lucia calls, drive to Hamlet Correctional Facility and talk to the reception guard. Then drive her to the Rusty Anchor, buy two Pindayho beers ($6), dance, play pool with Mattia, fight off the Aviators outside and run from the police to the beach. Finishing all five of Lucia's errands first starts the relationship at 3 of 4.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason at a prison visitors' window with a guard

blocks.title: Clean Up After Donnie (Donnie's Drop)
blocks.text: ||Donnie calls the morning after Coming Home. In the swamps south-west of Hamlet, talk to the fisherman on the dock and examine the package. Take the boat beside it to the shack downriver, deal with the three Kingfishers and take the cocaine to the container at Donnie's trailer in Key Lento. Reward: $600 in the mailbox.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason steering a small boat down a swamp channel

blocks.title: Buck Me (Set Up Bank Account)
blocks.text: ||Lucia calls about half a day after Coming Home. At the Fleeca bank in Key Lento, ask the teller, then follow the manager into his office. Afterwards open the purple B app on the phone: $100 is in checking. Move it with Checking Account, then Buck Yourself. Reward: the BuckMe app.||

blocks.title: Down to Earth
blocks.text: ||Needs Clean Up After Donnie and Buck Me. Talk to Brian in his marina office, pressure-wash the boat, then fly the seaplane with Lucia to Bobcat Bay in the far north-west. Deal with the enemies, land near three drop spots, hide the goods in the washing machine under the house and support Lucia with her parole officer. Lucia then teaches meditation, the first of 18 Meditation Spots.||
blocks.frameAlt: Brian at his desk in the marina office

blocks.title: Deposit Cash Into BuckMe
blocks.text: ||No map marker; it is in the mission list. In BuckMe, use ATM Finder, Set Destination, and deposit some pocket cash at the ATM near Jason's house. Money in Family Savings can never be taken out, but it cannot be lost either.||

blocks.title: Save for the Future
blocks.text: ||A repeating task done from the BuckMe app that runs through the whole story. Each Family Savings level raises the checking limit and adds a perk, from Buckin' Broke at $5,000 to Rich as Buck at $1,000,000. It does not block the story.||

blocks.title: Day Release (Meet Mattia & Kat)
blocks.text: ||A call after Down to Earth. Order a drink from the bartender at the back of the Rusty Anchor, take the speedboat to the yacht, race Mattia on jet skis and shoot the champagne bottles. Find Mattia two decks down, follow him to the Huxley Motel and the Nine1Nine club, then find Jason and jump from the balcony into the pool. Riding with Jason and holding hands raise the relationship.||
blocks.frameAlt: Two men talking on a wooden pier

blocks.title: Clear Skies (Join Donnie On A Job)
blocks.text: ||Opens after Down to Earth. Find Donnie at the seaplane in Southwind in the afternoon, then fly to the intercept point in the south-east and stay directly above Pilot Pete's plane to hide it from radar. Land at the north-west airstrip, fight the Final Chapter bikers, free Donnie from the chair, hold off the attackers and follow him by bike to the meeting point east of Watson Bay.||
blocks.frameAlt: Two men talking beside a seaplane

blocks.title: Building a Life
blocks.text: ||Starts at Jason's house straight after Clear Skies. Help Lucia put the coffee table together, redo the screws in the right order and set the glass top from the box. No reward.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason and Lucia leaning close together at home

blocks.text: Chapter 1,
The end of Chapter 1. Recalibration is the last chance to clear anything in Key Lento, because the chapter closes behind you once Tourist Trap begins.

blocks.caption: ||Swamped: A grinning man in a bandana in a boat workshop.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Swamped | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||A separate manual save, and at least $5,000 in Family Savings||

blocks.title: Swamped (Meet Brian)
blocks.text: ||Needs Day Release, Clear Skies and Building a Life. Enter the back room of Brian's Marina, drive with Brian to the Kingfishers' camp in the north-west, then fight your way out with him. Take the helicopter after Lori's boat, shoot the enemies, fly close and jump aboard. Telling Lucia about Brian's retirement afterwards raises the relationship.||
blocks.frameAlt: A grinning man in a bandana at the marina

blocks.title: Don Gone (Head to Donnie's Trailer)
blocks.text: ||Starts after Swamped at Donnie's trailer. Take the bag from the bed and pack the marked items: the photo above the bed, the flight schedule, clothes, his ID, the phone message and the map on the fridge. Drive north out of Key Lento and destroy the car, by burning it with the gas can from the trunk or sinking it. Missable: Donnie's H&L .38 in the car's trunk; take it before the car is destroyed.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason walking past a painted trailer

blocks.title: Donnie's Lost Drugs
blocks.text: ||Also opens after Swamped; PowerPyx's own page calls it optional. Take a boat to the search area off the north coast of Key Lento, dive in the south-east part to find a sunken boat, and open the compartment at its back. Reward: $1,200 when the bag is dropped at Brian's lockup.||
blocks.frameAlt: A sunken boat on the sea floor

blocks.title: Recalibration (Talk to Lucia)
blocks.text: ||Lucia calls during or after Don Gone and Donnie's Lost Drugs; it starts when you get home. Buy a six-pack, find Cal on the lounger behind his house, take the boat to the fishing spot and catch fish (cast with L2 + R2, push the left stick against the fish), then grill all three pieces. This is the fishing tutorial and the last free roam of Chapter 1.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason, Lucia and a friend at the back of a boat

blocks.title: Tourist Trap (Take Up Mattia's Offer)
blocks.text: ||Starts right after Recalibration in the far south of Key Lento. Take the bag from the locker in the Visitor Center and follow the objectives; the second half is played as Lucia, ending with a boat escape to Cal's house. Killing police here does not affect the criminal profile.||
blocks.frameAlt: A woman in a blonde wig beside Jason in a yellow shirt

blocks.title: Home Sweet Home
blocks.text: ||Played as Lucia straight after Tourist Trap. Enter Jason's house, fight off two attackers and get out of the front door in time, then stay crouched in the dark and leave the police search area, on foot or in a stolen car. PowerPyx says there is no time to reach Jason's stash of cash.||
blocks.frameAlt: A figure on the phone outside a house at night

blocks.title: Discharge Time
blocks.text: ||Starts on its own at Vice City Hospital. Go to the second floor, Room 203, follow the pink floor line, then shoot the attackers as Jason while Lucia pushes him, and defend the ambulance from the back. It leads straight into Chapter 2.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia in a skeleton-print jacket in the hospital lobby

blocks.title: Point of no return
items: ||Starting Tourist Trap ends Chapter 1 free roam. PowerPyx says pocket cash is lost and the Key Lento house is gone for good.||
||Shirley's two errands close as soon as Tourist Trap starts.||
||Kenton's dives, Cal's fishing and the Kingfishers' hideout icons go away for now; PowerPyx says Kenton comes back between Chapters 2 and 3, and his jobs stay open after the story.||

blocks.title: Before you go
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx suggests a permanent save in its own slot and at least $5,000 in Family Savings. Finish Find the Lost Drugs, the house repairs and Lucia's errands before Recalibration.||

pages.title: Chapter 1: Lucia's Errands and Other Extras

blocks.text: Chapter 1
Optional Chapter 1 jobs that close with the chapter. None is needed for the 100% checklist, but they raise the relationship with Lucia and pay out.

blocks.caption: ||Pick up Groceries: Jason in a grocery aisle full of cereal and snacks.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Pick up Groceries | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Feng Shui for the five errands; Day Release for Clock Out; Down to Earth for the drug search and meditation||

blocks.title: Pick up Groceries
blocks.text: ||Enter the marked grocery store in Key Lento and take any 3 items with pink markers; they are paid for as you pick them up. Load them into the trunk, drive home and carry them inside.||

blocks.title: Buy Flowers
blocks.text: ||Talk to the merchant at the flower stand in south Key Lento. A Large Bouquet costs $10 and Roses $25; either works, and they are delivered home.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason at an open-air flower stall

blocks.title: Buy Lucia a Necklace
blocks.text: ||Buy the engraved gold chain at The Siren's Chest in south Key Lento, next to the barbershop. PowerPyx gives $475 on this page and $425 on its Coming Home page. In Chapter 2 the necklace settles Overnight Charges at once.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason at the counter of a jewellery shop

blocks.title: Get The Chop
blocks.text: ||Pay for any haircut in the salon next to the jewellery shop. Hairstyles must be paid for again each time you switch back.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason in the barber's chair with hairstyle choices on screen

blocks.title: Get Lucia's Clothes
blocks.text: ||An unknown caller rings after Feng Shui. Talk to the bartender at the Manatee's Rest bar in north Key Lento, follow Andy to her car and put the bag in your trunk. Keep it there until you collect Lucia.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason meeting a woman under a bar awning

blocks.title: Clock Out
blocks.text: ||Lucia may call after Day Release asking for a ride. Pick her up at the Key Lento Community Center before 4pm and drive her home. Declining or arriving late ends it; PowerPyx says it may need a 3 of 4 relationship to appear.||
blocks.frameAlt: A red pickup outside the Key Lento Community Center

blocks.title: Meditate with Lucia
blocks.text: ||GTABase lists this the morning after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept. It counts toward the Positive Mental Attitude trophy and can only be done in Chapter 1.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia stepping out onto the wooden balcony at sunset

blocks.title: Find the Lost Drugs
blocks.text: ||A call after Down to Earth. Recreation Area: one package in a beach tree (shoot it down) and one off the end of the docks. Burned Houses: three, the last in a blue paddling pool. Pelican Valley: two on the ground among alligators. Thorpe Adventures: take the Half Brick of Cocaine from the two men in the shed. Sell the bags at a fence; they are lost if you are killed or arrested.||
blocks.frameAlt: A man wading toward a burnt-out stilt house

pages.title: Chapter 2: What's in the Bag? to How Do I Look?

blocks.text: Chapter 2,
Lucia takes over at the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. The early missions are short errands around Port Gellhorn, mostly opened by the first two.

blocks.caption: ||What's in the Bag?: Lucia reaching for a hidden bag in the dark.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("What's in the Bag? | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Ambulance Chaser, if not done before Slam Dunk (GTABase)||

blocks.title: What's in the Bag?
blocks.text: ||Opens Chapter 2 after Discharge Time. Flip the statue, read the note underneath and look at the hard drive. Reward: the Paradise Lost trophy, and Lucia becomes playable in the open world.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia holding a bag in a dim room

blocks.title: Take Care of Jason (Play Nurse)
blocks.text: ||No marker. Go back to the motel at the end of each day; it completes on its own after Breakfast Run as the other Chapter 2 missions are done. Reward: a relationship increase.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia inside the motel room

blocks.title: Overnight Charges (See Linda, The Manager)
blocks.text: ||Talk to Linda at the reception desk. If Jason bought the necklace in Chapter 1, Lucia hands it over as collateral and the mission ends there. Inspect the map on the reception wall to reveal Port Gellhorn.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia at the motel reception desk

blocks.title: Just Moved In
blocks.text: ||At the Alpha store across from the motel, take soda, protein bars, fruit, soup, gauze, bandanas, hair clippers and a makeup bag, then go back to the room. Items are paid for as you take them. Reward: a relationship increase.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia inside a convenience store

blocks.title: Ambulance Chaser (Move the Ambulance)
blocks.text: ||The ambulance is in a barn east of the motel. Chase it on the ATV until it hits a tree, pour gasoline from the red can and light it, or throw the can in the back and shoot it. Leave quickly, since the blast brings the police.||
blocks.frameAlt: An ambulance parked in a dark garage

blocks.title: Girl's Trip (Find Painkillers)
blocks.text: ||Needs Overnight Charges and Just Moved In. Ask Zach, pay Vicki $50 in Room 10, then ride with her to Delights and on to look for Dunk: his trailer, the boatyard and a car wash. Choosing Defuse twice with the Kolts avoids a fight and earns Professional standing. Chase Dunk to the farm and drive him home. Reward: $50 back through BuckMe.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia at a motel room door

blocks.title: Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)
blocks.text: ||Drive a car into Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn. Scan the three cars in the yard with WAiNK, take the Slim Jim and open the Montagne XL with it. Bring a car with no tracker, not one stolen near the garage, then respray and register it. Rewards: the Slim Jim, the Scooter Bros app, a registered car for Lucia, and Moses as a buyer for untracked cars.||

blocks.title: New Look
blocks.text: ||Buy any hairstyle at the hair salon in Port Gellhorn.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia and a stylist in a pink hair salon

blocks.title: How Do I Look?
blocks.text: ||Buy any top and trousers or shorts; PowerPyx points to Bargain World in south Port Gellhorn.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia in a denim jacket among clothing racks

pages.title: Chapter 2: Painkiller Supplier to Checking Out

blocks.text: Chapter 2,
Dunk, Moses and Vicki's jobs, the two leads back together, and the move to Vice City. Checking Out ends the chapter for good.

blocks.caption: ||Painkiller Supplier: A white pickup with a traffic cone in the back, a subtitle at the bottom.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Painkiller Supplier | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||$900 for Behind on Payments; at least $15,000 before Checking Out||
||Dunk as a fence, garages, free switching between the two leads||

blocks.title: Painkiller Supplier
blocks.text: ||A wait with no marker: Dunk calls after a few in-game days, the step renames itself Dunk Will Be in Touch, and a second call starts Slam Dunk. Doing the other Chapter 2 missions helps the call arrive.||

blocks.title: Behind on Payments
blocks.text: ||Pay Linda $900 at reception once you have it. Selling cars to Moses, mugging or emptying shop tills raises the money.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia at the motel counter facing the manager

blocks.title: Slam Dunk
blocks.text: ||Starts at Dunk's trailer. Follow Dunk to the docks and the office, reverse out of the compound, lose the Kolts, pick up Dr. Bill and defend yourself at the airstrip south-west of Port Gellhorn, then take Dunk home. Rewards: $1,700 through BuckMe the next day, Dunk as a fence and two robbery spots marked by his call.||

blocks.title: Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)
blocks.text: ||Moses texts a photo after Moses. The white '82 Crawler is in the middle of the search area; fight the guards or just drive off, and deliver it to his garage. Reward: $1,250, plus $500 in good condition. Moses then gifts the Port Gellhorn Garage and the Vice City Real Estate app opens.||

blocks.title: Breakfast Run (Check on Jason)
blocks.text: ||Jason calls about half a day after Slam Dunk. Rob Hank's Waffles, a liquor store and a thrift store, then two more stores together; aim at the staff and threaten them, with a minute for each. Lose the two-star wanted level on the small off-road paths. Rewards: the Trust trophy and a car each.||
blocks.frameAlt: A waffle-diner billboard on a sunny street

blocks.title: Coffee Break
blocks.text: ||Follows straight on. Buy Lucia a $2 coffee from the machine in the motel kitchen, go back to the car and hold Right on the D-pad to talk to your partner. Reward: free switching between Jason and Lucia. Four jobs are then marked: Thrillbillies, Hit Avery Pawn, Hit Kingpin Bowling and Impounded Vehicle.||
blocks.frameAlt: A tourist map spread on a table

blocks.title: Prepare for Vice City
blocks.text: ||Starts in the motel's coffee room. Save up at least $15,000; once the other main missions are done, the motel room is marked. PowerPyx suggests the four side jobs, Billy's first two jobs, Bret Vogel's first hunt and Afternoon Delight for money.||

blocks.title: Afternoon Delight (Rob Vicki's Boss)
blocks.text: ||Vicki calls after Coffee Break. At Delights, Jason climbs the fence at the back once the bouncers leave. The safe code is 2008. Shoot your way out, escape the bikers and give Vicki the bag. The choice in the dressing room changes the route but not the result. Reward: $10,000 from Vicki the next day.||

blocks.title: Checking Out (Move to Vice City)
blocks.text: ||Needs every Chapter 2 main mission and $15,000. Use the bathroom door in your room. Take the shotgun from the bed, regroup in the cafeteria, then as Lucia take a biker's motorbike, chase Jason's car, jump across and shoot police tyres. GTABase says dying in the bike chase can break the mission; restart it if Jason disappears from the objectives.||

blocks.title: Point of no return
items: ||Starting Checking Out ends Chapter 2 and the Starlet Motel stops being home for good. Finish the Chapter 2 side jobs first.||

blocks.text: Chapter 2
Coffee Break marks four optional jobs at once. They are good money toward the $15,000 for Vice City, plus a pistol hunt in between.

blocks.caption: ||Pick Up A Gun: Lucia walking along a roadside past a mini-mart sign.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Pick Up A Gun | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Coffee Break (Pick Up A Gun after Girl's Trip)||
||Sticky bombs for the bowling alley safe, Zombix and body armour||

blocks.title: Pick Up A Gun
blocks.text: ||Optional, after Girl's Trip. Buy a weapon at Gellhorn Outfitters, the Ammu-Nation in Port Gellhorn, or take one you own from the green locker.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia inside the gun shop

blocks.title: Hit Avery Pawn
blocks.text: ||Draw on the staff and smash the cases. Staff may give the back safe's code; PowerPyx's was 6499 but may be random. Breaking glass brings a two-star wanted level. Sell the bag at Dunk's trailer. Pay depends on what you take.||

blocks.title: Hit Kingpin Bowling
blocks.text: ||Three valuables count for the Let's Go Bowling trophy: the Luxury Watch in the south-east room, the Gutterball Moreland 850 on the pool table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the small north-east office, opened with sticky bombs. Escape a two-star wanted level. A missed item respawns in Chapter 3.||

blocks.title: Impounded Vehicle
blocks.text: ||Lucia's car is in the impound near the Port Gellhorn police station, marked with a green car icon. Driving through the fence brings a two-star wanted level. Reward: Lucia's car back. Later impounds can be paid off in the Scooter Bros app.||

pages.title: Chapter 3: Welcome to Vice City to Meet the Heders

blocks.text: Chapter 3,
The pair arrive in Vice City. Dre'Quan, Mia, Tyrone, Boobie and Brian all hand out work; several steps are phone tasks.

blocks.caption: ||Welcome to Vice City: Two men talking in a nightclub.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Welcome to Vice City | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||$5,000 each for two transfers to Lorena||
||Tyrone and Yasmani as drop-offs, the Cut-off Tool||

blocks.title: Welcome to Vice City
blocks.text: ||Starts on its own after Checking Out. Drive to the Jack of Hearts, go round to the back entrance, follow Dre'Quan upstairs, then drive to the apartment, park in the covered spot and enter the first door on the second floor. Rewards: Bayside Apartments 201 and a trophy; Moses then texts that Pay 'n' Sprays will register cars with Standard Trackers.||

blocks.title: Dealer's Choice (Go See Dre'Quan)
blocks.text: ||Jason only. Find Dre'Quan in the recording booth upstairs at the Jack of Hearts, collect the product from a nearby apartment, choose Pure or Cut, and take the money at the deal. Knock out the man who grabs the bag and drive Dre'Quan to Southside. Cut is spotted, but can be sold at half price. PowerPyx lists $1,500.||
blocks.frameAlt: Two men in caps in a dim recording studio

blocks.title: Dubious Provenance (Visit the Antique Store)
blocks.text: ||Three parts, started from the bag in the apartment closet. Part 1: visit the antique store in Capri. Part 2: get into Evelyn Andrews Antiques by the rear window above the air conditioner, take the statue from the desk drawer and search the motel next door. Part 3: chase on a jet ski, foot and bike, then loot the storage container (about $2,500 and a '32 Hustler). Ignoring Call Halifax loses Parts 2 and 3 at the end of the chapter.||

blocks.title: Mami Knows Best (Catch Up With Mia)
blocks.text: ||Lucia only, from Peacock Bay. Drive Mia to the house in Hamlet, clear the lawn into the blue dumpster, pull the mattress from the pool with her, then use the excavator across the street on the house and cars, and drive her to her office. No reward.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia in the passenger seat of a car

blocks.title: Get Your Wheels
blocks.text: ||Optional and in the mission list only. Register a car at a Pay 'n' Spray, or get an impounded one back with Scooter Bros for roughly $700 to $900. Reward: a personal vehicle for Chapter 3. GTABase marks it as needed for 100%.||

blocks.title: Here, Kitty Kitty (Speak with Tyrone)
blocks.text: ||Jason only, after Dubious Provenance Part 1. Speak with Tyrone in La Perle, go to Charles' apartment in Rockridge (a $20 bribe or the receipt in the bedroom gives the address), then chase him through the camp on La Perle's north-west edge. Reward: Tyrone as a drop-off for goods, and the Kitty Litter Labs begin.||

blocks.title: Send Money to Lorena
blocks.text: ||Lucia only, after Mami Knows Best. Lorena calls; open BuckMe and send her $5,000 from checking.||
blocks.frameAlt: A phone showing a payment screen with $5,000

blocks.title: Encrypted Hard Drive
blocks.text: ||Jason only. Cal visits the apartment some time after Dealer's Choice or Dubious Provenance; then wait about a day for Brian's call, which completes it and opens Meet the Heders.||

blocks.title: Boobie Time (Talk to Boobie)
blocks.text: ||Jason only, after Dubious Provenance Part 1. Drive Boobie to two pick-ups, chase the thieves down the river on a jet ski and pick up the cash bag, then go to the smoke shop to meet Yasmani. Reward: Yasmani as a drop-off; he pays more for jewellery and marked bills.||
blocks.frameAlt: Two men talking in a red-lit room

blocks.title: Meet the Heders (Meet Brian & Lori)
blocks.text: ||Start from the bag of clothes in the bedroom. Meet Brian at the restaurant (order the Surf and Turf for a relationship boost), take the white van to the dockyard and cut into the yellow container on top of the central stack. Chase the truck on a bike, free the car, lose the police and drive to the lockup. Reward: the Cut-off Tool; the first orange container holds a cigar and $600.||

pages.title: Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to Raul's Next Job

blocks.text: Chapter 3,
Raul's crew arrives and the first bank jobs open. Credit Check is the mission that turns banks and payday loan stores into targets.

blocks.caption: ||Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: Yasmani at his desk, handing over a snap gun.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Snap Gun, Dye Pack Jammer, Key Cloner, Randy as a buyer, bank and payday loan robberies||
||Safe codes for the three jewellery stores are on the Yasmani page||

blocks.title: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
blocks.text: ||After Boobie Time. Rob Casa de Empeno, Richardson Jewelry and Donovan Banks & Co. in any order, taking one marked item from each safe, then sell to Yasmani. Do Casa de Empeno first: it has no back door, and delivering after the first store gets you the Snap Gun. Reward: $20,000 for the items plus anything else you take. Full codes and security notes are on the Yasmani page.||

blocks.title: Car Service (Steal The Car for Raul)
blocks.text: ||Lucia only, about a day after Meet the Heders, at a marker in Salton. A nearby car's trunk holds flash grenades and a silenced Klose K17. Climb the white van on the north side onto the roof, take the Schafter V12 from the covered area and deliver it to Leonida Auto World in far north-west Vice City. Leave the dog by the gate alone. Reward: $3,000, Randy as a car buyer, and the wanted areas in Port Gellhorn and Key Lento cleared.||

blocks.title: Send More Money to Lorena
blocks.text: ||A few days after the first transfer, send another $5,000 through BuckMe.||

blocks.title: Top Billing (Watch the Real Dimez)
blocks.text: ||After Car Service, at the Jack of Hearts. Go backstage, follow Roxy, stop at Peewees, then go to the house party near VCIA. Open the kitchen door so the dog draws Jacki away, knock Kamal out, and as Jason cut the power at the green box on the corner. No reward.||
blocks.frameAlt: Two women in a dressing room

blocks.title: First Impressions (Meeting with Raul)
blocks.text: ||Both leads, at Waxman Island; the garage code is 2404. Drive to the meet in south Ocean Beach, hold off the police from the car (aim for tyres and engines to keep a Professional rating), cross to Rialto Islands, swap into the van and drive Raul to Bayside. Reward: $3,000.||

blocks.title: Crosstown Traffic (Meet Raul)
blocks.text: ||Lucia starts at the Courtyard Bar in Stockyard, Jason at the La Perle boatyard. Jason follows a boat by bike while Lucia boards the metro, pressures the Guardia Brother and hits the emergency stop; Jason hijacks the boat and defends it. Reward: $3,000.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia on a station platform beside a metro train

blocks.title: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)
blocks.text: ||Both leads, at the intercom by Vice Vinyl in Crosstown. Take a mask and the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob three Fleeca branches: Washington Beach (four marked drawers), Ocean Beach (back door with Snap Gun, safe code from the teller or a charge) and south Ocean Beach (drawers only; leave when the alarm sounds). Lose the police and answer the door at Bayside. Reward: $6,000, the Jammer, and bank and payday loan robberies.||
blocks.frameAlt: A woman on the phone in a dim office

blocks.title: Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)
blocks.text: ||Install the key cloner from the phone, climb the wall of the Hathaway Apartments garage in Ocean Beach and clone the key of the Zorrusso on the ground floor, east side. Keep moving so the tracker does not alert the police; it switches off near Randy's showroom. Reward: $21,250, plus $10,000 in very good condition, and Randy's Wish List.||
blocks.frameAlt: A red Zorrusso supercar in a walled garage

blocks.title: Ride Or Die (Meet Dre'Quan)
blocks.text: ||Jason only, a day after Credit Check. At the Eris store, get DWNPLY sneakers ($1,580, or throw a basketball to make the man drop his bag), show them to the bouncer, swap them for DWNPLY's keys, honk to find his car and drive to the Stockyard Speedshop. No reward.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason and a man in camo looking at a phone

blocks.title: Raul's Next Job
blocks.text: ||A wait after Credit Check. Raul's message usually arrives within a day and opens Sinfrontera National Bank.||
The Cartel Heist
Raul's heist has its own run of preparation jobs. How well two of them go decides how long you get on the day.

blocks.caption: ||Sinfrontera National Bank: Jason in the bright atrium of a bank.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Sinfrontera National Bank | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Sinfrontera National Bank, Security Expert, then Company Property; Safe Word and The Missing Link follow||
||Cargo kept in Company Property sets the number of bombs in Hidden Charges||

blocks.title: Sinfrontera National Bank (Scope Out the Bank)
blocks.text: ||Enter the bank in Tequesta, lean at the table with Jason and use L3 + R3 to pick out four things: the cameras above the counter, the man in the pink suit, the two guards by the lift and the security panel between the lifts. Then sit with Raul and Andrea upstairs.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason walking into a marble bank lobby

blocks.title: Security Expert
blocks.text: ||Starts after the bank visit, in Waning Sands. Drive slowly past the house, park, sneak in the back once the guard leaves, find the bedroom in the north-east corner, then follow Jason closely around the side to the car and take Nicole to the planning room in Stockyard.||
blocks.frameAlt: A woman in glasses leaning on a desk with computers

blocks.title: Caught Slipping
blocks.text: ||Starts when you next enter the Bayside apartment after Boobie Time and First Impressions. Stop each thief with a Focus shot to the legs (L3 + R3), search the bags, then go to Big House Storage and follow Jason up to his unit.||

blocks.title: Heist Planning
blocks.text: ||An umbrella task added after Security Expert. It finishes by itself when The Cartel Heist starts, once all the preparation jobs are done.||

blocks.title: Company Property (Meet Brian)
blocks.text: ||Speak to Brian at Skeeter's bar in Hamlet. Load Pete's crates at the airfield south of Hamlet, escape through the hangar with the assault rifle, take off in the plane, and as Lucia use the LMG in the truck bed to stop cars ramming it. Crash-land in the coloured field right of the river. Every crate lost means fewer bombs later.||

blocks.title: Safe Word (Steal the Practice Safe)
blocks.text: ||Speak to Nicole at Raul's compound. Drive the truck to Gil's mansion in Peacock Estates, blend in as pool staff, deal with Rodney, then find the safe remote in the left desk drawer of Gil's office. Winch the safe out through the window, avoid cyclists and gravestones on the way, and deliver it to Felipe. Finish the safecracking practice for Gil's Kalinga .50; the safe holds $1,500.||
blocks.frameAlt: A woman standing over two seated men by a pool

blocks.text: Chapter 3,
The last Chapter 3 jobs and the heist itself. The Cartel Heist needs every other Chapter 3 main mission done first.

blocks.caption: ||Hidden Charges: Two dark figures in an alley behind two red sports bags.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Hidden Charges | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Monty's 1992 pistol in The Missing Link; Boobie's red bag in Bricked Up||
||About 11 minutes if all 3 cell towers are blown||

blocks.title: The Missing Link (Meet Andrea)
blocks.text: ||Lucia alone, at Sloppy Molly's in Watson Bay. Follow Andrea, knock Monty out in the back room and clear a path out. Later, as Jason, keep him above the water with the loader during the questioning to keep the Professional bonus. Missable: Monty's 1992 pistol; after the first enemy, go back to the photo room for it.||

blocks.title: Cooties (Shoot the Music Video)
blocks.text: ||Dre'Quan calls a couple of days after Ride Or Die. Hold R2 to drive the circle for the video, fight off two attackers, swing the bat and spray the car, then escape in DWNPLY's car and drop it at the studio. Reward: Bae-Luxe's Bat.||

blocks.title: Hidden Charges (Prepping the Explosives)
blocks.text: ||Karim calls after Cooties. Drive the van to the downtown garage and plant charges on the East tower (west building with the helipad, then the walkway), the South tower (lift past the pool, then the ladder) and, if you have a third bomb, the West tower in the north construction building. Using both leads is faster and raises the relationship. Grab a parachute from a rooftop box to get away.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia and Jason walking toward two red sports bags

blocks.title: Bricked Up (Return to the Apartment)
blocks.text: ||Needs Hidden Charges and the other remaining main missions. Park outside the red area near Venture Apartments in Rockridge or the car is impounded. Ask for Raymond, knock on the red door upstairs, then fight your way out, help Lucia down from the window and lose the police on the way to the Jack of Hearts. Missable: the red bag near the end of the first room, worth $3,500 and a Professional bonus.||

blocks.title: South Leonida Real Estate (Meet Mia)
blocks.text: ||Lucia only; Mia can take many in-game days to get in touch after Mami Knows Best. Read the note on her office door in Hamlet, tail a car while keeping its arrow white, search the building through the south door of the back alley, then visit three properties. At the last, fight off the M7 with only a pistol at first, picking up their guns. A standoff ends it. Reward: $2,000, paid many days later.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia at the glass door of an estate agent's office

blocks.title: The Cartel Heist
blocks.text: ||Raul calls; start at the planning room in Stockyard. Blow the towers, then drive south to the bank against the clock. Inside: knock out the marked guard, herd the hostages, take the lift as Lucia, fight up to the roof as Jason and drill the vault. Loot the bill stacks first, they are worth more. Then hold the lobby, get out through the basement delivery bay, steal the SWAT vehicle and protect the bus to the freeway. Reward: $120,000 and the Break the Bank trophy.||
blocks.frameAlt: A Stockyard street lined with murals and lowered cars

blocks.title: Keep a Professional rating
blocks.text: ||In the heist, shoot weapons out of guards' hands rather than killing them. PowerPyx says it is the only thing you can lose here.||
Chapter 4,
A new home at the Y Hotel and a new set of employers. Pay Abe's Fee is the biggest single bill in the story, so have $75,000 ready.

blocks.caption: ||Ocean Beach: A woman in a pink blazer smiling in a bright lobby.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Ocean Beach | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||BuckMe Black account ($2,000,000 limit), a car each, Pilot Pete and Eddie Acosta||

blocks.title: Ocean Beach
blocks.text: ||From the Bayside apartment after The Cartel Heist, straight away or on your next visit. Drive to the Y Hotel, meet Valentina, take the lift to the 7th floor and Room 701 at the far end, open the wardrobe and bring Lucia a glass on the balcony. Reward: Room 701; the wardrobe has new outfits from now on.||
blocks.frameAlt: A woman in a pink blazer in a green-lit hotel lobby

blocks.title: Another Life
blocks.text: ||Played as Lucia straight after Ocean Beach, in Washington Beach. A short scripted mission that ends with a cutscene. Reward: the BuckMe Black account with a $2,000,000 limit, and the Vice City, Baby! trophy.||

blocks.title: Pool Day
blocks.text: ||As Jason, get Lucia a Tequila Sunrise from the bar past the pool, give it to her and walk to the beach. You meet Eddie Acosta at the bar, which leads to his optional party; Valentina's call at the end marks the next two missions. Pilot Pete calls shortly after.||
blocks.frameAlt: A hotel pool lined with palm trees seen from a shaded bar

blocks.title: Company Cars (Speak to the Concierge)
blocks.text: ||Talk to Santino in the lobby; the hotel car service takes you to Status Auto Imports for free. Pick a car for Jason, then for Lucia, chase her and race back to the hotel. Both cars are yours to keep, modify or sell; PowerPyx names the Pfister Comet S2 as the fastest. The dealership cars can be scanned with WAiNK. PowerPyx's garage guide adds the Thompson Court Garage.||

blocks.title: Lawyer Up (Meet Abe Gonzalez)
blocks.text: ||Valentina gets in touch after Pool Day. At Abe's office in Downtown, the receptionist sends you to Sandy at the back, then go upstairs. No reward.||
blocks.frameAlt: A lawyer in glasses behind his desk

blocks.title: Heavy Lifting (Bring Raul the Hard Drive)
blocks.text: ||Collect the hard drive from the storage locker in Crosstown and take it to Raul's houseboat, then go to Ajax Gym. Change at the locker, search Raina's backpack, find Nate in the tanning room and his plans in the WhatUp app, then tail the bodybuilders to the Grand Majestic Aparthotel roof, keeping their arrow white. No reward.||
blocks.frameAlt: A man in sunglasses on the deck of a yacht

blocks.title: It's A Date!
blocks.text: ||Marked in Stockyard after Heavy Lifting, for both leads. Buy a drink at the Courtyard Bar and walk back to the street. Reward: a relationship increase. PowerPyx now lists it as optional; GTABase lists it as a story mission needed for 100%.||

blocks.title: Party Hard (Work Personal Security)
blocks.text: ||Meet Valentina at VCIA. Follow the car, pick up Andres' order in Little Cuba and go to the Megamundo offices in Downtown. Upstairs, take the radio, clear the stairwell with a silenced pistol that has no spare ammo, rescue the Navarros and land the helicopter on the helipad.||

blocks.title: Pay Abe's Fee
blocks.text: ||A text from the law firm after Party Hard. Pay $75,000 through BuckMe; the story cannot continue without it.||

blocks.title: Photo/Shoot (Shoot a Promo)
blocks.text: ||Dre'Quan calls after Party Hard; go to the roof in Tequesta. As Lucia, photograph the Dimez from the helicopter with the phone camera, follow Dre'Quan's car into a building on a bike, then fight through to his car under the highway. Reward: $6,000, Roxy's W-10 and Bae-Luxe's W-10.||

pages.title: Chapter 4: Bad Driver! to Nate Will Be in Touch

blocks.text: Chapter 4,
Preparation for the airport job begins, with Lucia at Ajax Gym and Jason at the airport. Bad Driver! closes once Power Play is done.

blocks.caption: ||Bad Driver!: Jason and a man in a white vest inside a ruined wooden shack.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Bad Driver! | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Mostly one lead at a time: Lucia for the gym jobs, Jason for the airport and Dre'Quan||
||After Making Gainz the two cannot be together in public until VCIA Takedown, except in their hotel room||

blocks.title: Bad Driver! (Find Felipe)
blocks.text: ||Optional, from Andrea after Party Hard, at a bar in Millport, Lummox County. Felipe leaves the bathroom and runs out the back into the woods; slow him with shots to the back or legs, then melee him. The choice at the end decides the reward: $20,000 from Andrea, or the follow-up Collect Felipe's Gift, which hands over his car. Missable after Power Play.||

blocks.title: Making Gainz (Meet Raul)
blocks.text: ||Lucia alone at the planning room in Stockyard, a couple of days after Heavy Lifting. At Ajax Gym, get Nate's attention, use the bench press, squat rack, deadlift and exercise bike, then meet Jason. Turning down the steroid offer is the default; accepting changes Lucia's build for the rest of the game. No reward; opens the gym's Trauma Floor.||

blocks.title: Blood Sweat and Gear (Work Out)
blocks.text: ||Lucia, at Ajax Gym on Oldby Island. Change at the locker on the Trauma Floor, work out beside Raina, then Nate and Francisco, then the deadlift on stage with Kordell, and talk to the rest of the crew before leaving.||

blocks.title: Too Much Baggage (Scope Out the Airport)
blocks.text: ||Jason, from Andrea, at VCIA. Follow Omar, hook two trailers to the baggage tug and throw bags to him (release near the halfway mark), then slip away to the security office restroom to plant the device. Tell Omar you want the job to finish.||
blocks.frameAlt: A baggage handler in a hi-vis vest on the airport apron

blocks.title: Watch It (Meet Dre'Quan)
blocks.text: ||Jason, at a store in Washington Beach. Drive Dre'Quan to the Cruda car park, meet the Crowex dealer on the top floor and fight, escape before the police come, then go to Nola in south Ocean Beach (pick one of two outfits to keep) and through the Doight d'Or hotel. No reward.||

blocks.title: Amateur Hour (Workout)
blocks.text: ||Lucia, back at the gym, from Francisco. Change on the Trauma Floor, drive his car to the pick-up, wait on the bench, stop the Coochie Camper (shooting the tyres is quickest), then drop him at the back of Ajax Gym and park in his spot. Reward: $1,000.||
blocks.frameAlt: A tattooed man in a dark basement gym

blocks.title: Call Nate
blocks.text: ||Lucia only. A short follow-up between Amateur Hour and Cash Injections; PowerPyx had no page for it.||

blocks.title: Cash Injections (Hang Out With Nate)
blocks.text: ||Lucia, at the Muscle Beach gym in Ocean Beach. Ride with Nate to the deal in a back alley, open his trunk, knock away a gun and protect him, then chase his car, clear the motel lot to get it back, lose the police and drive to the market shop in northern Vice Beach.||
blocks.frameAlt: People gathered by a car in a dim parking area

blocks.title: Dirty Work (Deal with Raina)
blocks.text: ||Needs Too Much Baggage and Cash Injections; meet Andrea in the planning room. Go to the Velvet Palm Motel in Tequesta, take the shipping containers as a vantage point and photograph Raina through the window. Meet Nate at the pool the next day as Lucia.||
blocks.frameAlt: A brick building seen through a camera vignette

blocks.title: Nate Will Be in Touch
blocks.text: ||A story step listed after Dirty Work; its map label is Help Kordell's Crew. Neither guide had a walkthrough for it.||

pages.title: Chapter 4: Adventures in Babysitting to Fully Catered

blocks.text: Chapter 4,
Jason works for Andres while Lucia works with Kordell's crew. One optional job here is on a timer.

blocks.caption: ||Adventures in Babysitting: A man in a straw hat and patterned shirt talking by a lit pool at night.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Adventures in Babysitting | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||This is a Free Call From... (Lucia), soon after it appears||
||$10,000 Fresh Evidence, $30,000 Child's Play, $40,000 Power Play||

blocks.title: Adventures in Babysitting (Work Security for Andres)
blocks.text: ||Jason, at Andres' home on Starfish Island. Drive to The Vault, escort him, fetch his drink and take his photo, deal with the bartender, Donatello's security and the dealer, then protect him, cross the tracks and defend the helicopter at the helipad. Hurting fleeing civilians lowers the criminal profile.||
blocks.frameAlt: A man in a straw fedora by a lit pool at night

blocks.title: Rafa's Kidnapping
blocks.text: ||Jason only. A story step with no walkthrough from PowerPyx or GTABase yet.||

blocks.title: Fresh Evidence (Meet Dre'Quan)
blocks.text: ||Needs Watch It and Adventures in Babysitting; Dre'Quan at the Jack of Hearts. At the Starfish Island mansion at night, hide the guard, Snap Gun the door, take the key card from the bedroom side table, distract guards with bottles and the tiger with raw meat, and find the hidden surveillance room. Copy the files, fight back to the dock and escape by speedboat. Reward: $10,000.||
blocks.frameAlt: A modern villa gate behind palm trees

blocks.title: Child's Play
blocks.text: ||From Andres at Megamundo HQ after Fresh Evidence. Go to the quarry, use binoculars at the deal, then switch between the two leads to get Rafa out and chase Gustavo. The map shows a timer, but PowerPyx says the mission is only forced before Power Play. Reward: $30,000 and the Family Matters trophy.||
blocks.frameAlt: Two men in an office, one at a desk phone

blocks.title: This is a Free Call From... (Pick up Shayna)
blocks.text: ||Optional and time-limited, for Lucia after Lawyer Up; Shayna messages when Lucia is in or near Hamlet. Collect her at the prison, take her to Raph's house in Southside and split the bag. Talking down the people inside pays least; the guide puts the most at about $6,500 in fenceable goods.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia outside a chain-link gate at night

blocks.title: Power Play (Help Kordell's Crew)
blocks.text: ||After Child's Play, at Kordell's base in Salton. Ask the receptionist, get in by the roof and lower door, flip the whiteboard in the planning room for the plans, place cones on the road, cover the crew with an assault rifle, then steal a car and lose the police; take the first right on the highway to miss the roadblock. Reward: $40,000. Bad Driver! closes once this is done.||
blocks.frameAlt: A gym whiteboard headed Mega Muscle Bootcamp

blocks.title: Close Surveillance (Spy on the Bodybuilders)
blocks.text: ||Jason only. Guides had no walkthrough yet; GTABase marks it as needed for 100%.||
blocks.frameAlt: A man holding a controller in a dark room

blocks.title: Delivery Method (Help Andrea)
blocks.text: ||Jason only. No published walkthrough yet.||
blocks.frameAlt: A man handing a woman a folded red garment

blocks.title: Team Building (Meet Kordell)
blocks.text: ||Lucia only. No published walkthrough yet.||
blocks.frameAlt: Silhouetted figures behind a chain-link fence

blocks.title: Fully Catered (Steal a Catering Truck)
blocks.text: ||Both leads. No published walkthrough yet; the map label says what to do.||
blocks.frameAlt: A woman in a cap beside a white box truck

pages.title: Chapter 4: Heist Plans in Place to Starting From Zero

blocks.text: Chapter 4,
The end of Chapter 4. Most of these had no published walkthrough yet, so this page gives the order, the map labels and what each is known to unlock.

blocks.caption: ||VCIA Takedown: Vans and a crew at night below large lit VICE CITY letters.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("VCIA Takedown | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||That's Where The Money Is..., which opens the 8 bank vaults||
||DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked, Top Of The World, Ma||

blocks.title: Heist Plans in Place
blocks.text: ||A story step after Fully Catered. No walkthrough published.||

blocks.title: Headliners (Help With The Launch Party)
blocks.text: ||Both leads. Reward: the DWNFALL trophy, which cannot be missed.||

blocks.title: VCIA Takedown (Start the Airport Heist)
blocks.text: ||Both leads, using the crew and equipment from the preparation jobs. Reward: the Hi-Jacked trophy; afterwards Yasmani gets in touch about That's Where The Money Is...||
blocks.frameAlt: Vehicles below a huge lit Vice City letter sign at night

blocks.title: Tie Up Loose Ends
blocks.text: ||A waiting step with no map marker. Raul never calls about the hard drive; Valentina does, and calling her back (Call Valentina Back) speeds things up. Later a note at the Y Hotel front desk starts Sunset, which ends this step. Meanwhile That's Where The Money Is... opens. No reward; needed for 100%, cannot be missed.||

blocks.title: That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe)
blocks.text: ||Optional, from Yasmani. Sit by the window at Cafe Orquidea in Ocean Beach, tail the security van at a distance, follow the guard into the bank, mask up, blow the back doorway and take the marked bills from the cart. Expect four stars and no back exit. Reward: about $80,000 if every bill is taken, the A Classic Blitz Play trophy if not already earned, and the bank vaults open. Full steps are on the Yasmani page.||

blocks.title: Call Valentina Back
blocks.text: ||A phone call: dial Valentina from either lead's phone, or pick the objective on the map. It makes Sunset appear sooner; skipping it only means a longer wait. No reward.||

blocks.title: Sunset (Stop by the Front Desk)
blocks.text: ||Both leads, starting at the hotel front desk. No walkthrough published.||

blocks.title: Starting From Zero
blocks.text: ||The last Chapter 4 mission. PowerPyx ties the Top Of The World, Ma trophy (Complete Chapter 4) to it; GTABase shows that trophy on Bird in the Hand.||

blocks.title: Before Starting From Zero
blocks.text: ||Do That's Where The Money Is... as soon as Yasmani calls: it opens the vault robberies needed for 100%, and his security-van tips once his earlier jobs are done.||

items: ||Whether the end of Chapter 4 is a point of no return like Chapters 1 and 2. No allowed guide says.||

blocks.text: Chapter
The last ten missions. Walkthroughs had not been published by the guides this app uses, so this page lists the order, map labels, trophies and unlocks only. Nothing about how the story ends.

blocks.caption: ||Bird in the Hand: A white helicopter on a rooftop helipad among city towers.||
blocks.credit: Picture from GTABase's mission guide ("Bird in the Hand | GTA 6 Mission Guide & Walkthrough"), gtabase.com

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||A second Pay Abe's Fee; the amount is not reported||

blocks.title: Bird in the Hand
blocks.text: ||Both leads. GTABase shows the Top Of The World, Ma trophy (Complete Chapter 4) on this mission.||

blocks.title: Taking Liberties
blocks.text: ||Second in Chapter 5. No walkthrough published.||

blocks.title: Doggie Bag (Meet Vinny) and VC Baby (Talk to Mattia)
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx puts Doggie Bag third and VC Baby fourth; GTABase and PC Gamer put VC Baby first. Do whichever is marked.||

blocks.title: Operation Savage Glory
blocks.text: ||Reward: the Snow Storm trophy. PowerPyx's garage guide lists the NE 15th Street Garage (2 spaces) and the Pegassi Residences Garage (3 spaces) as rewards.||

blocks.title: Honest Abe (Negotiate a Deal with Abe)
blocks.text: ||Ultimate Edition owners: PowerPyx says the '95 Grotti Cheetah then gets a purple icon in the underground car park of Pegassi Residences, Tequesta Retreat.||

blocks.title: Unfinished Business
blocks.text: ||Seventh in Chapter 5. No walkthrough published.||

blocks.title: Pay Abe's Fee (Chapter 5)
blocks.text: ||A second fee step. GTABase lists it as a story mission; no guide gives the amount.||

blocks.title: Protective Custody (Meet with Abe)
blocks.text: ||Both leads. No walkthrough published.||

blocks.title: The End of the Road
blocks.text: ||The final mission. GTABase ties the gold trophy You Gotta Know When to Get Off to it. Finishing it unlocks the 100% checklist.||

items: ||Objectives, givers and rewards for most Chapter 5 missions.||
||The amount of the Chapter 5 Pay Abe's Fee.||
||Where the pair live in Chapter 5.||

blocks.text: Side work:
Jason's neighbour in Key Lento. Two short errands that exist only in Chapter 1.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Once Pipework is available; she calls out to Jason near his house||
||Not the Strangers & Freaks trophy, and not needed for 100%||

blocks.title: Meeting Shirley
blocks.text: ||Push Square says she calls out as Jason pulls up at home after Unwanted Attention, or phones while he heads to Pipework. PowerPyx says she appears once Pipework is available. Agree to fetch her rum.||

blocks.title: Get Shirley's Rum: the store
blocks.text: ||Three Sheets Liquor is marked by a purple bottle icon south of the house. Ask the clerk for the rum. Asking about the bird noises from the back marks a front for later.||

blocks.title: Get Shirley's Rum: the delivery
blocks.text: ||Take the bottle back to Shirley. Reward: a Focus increase and a Professional rating increase.||

blocks.title: Steal the Scooter
blocks.text: ||Shirley calls about a day later. Take Peggy's scooter from the driveway beside the stairs, ride it back and park it inside Shirley's house. Peggy cannot recognise Jason. PowerPyx lists no reward.||
blocks.frameAlt: A pink mobility scooter being ridden down a road

blocks.title: Missable
items: ||Both close for good once Tourist Trap starts. Push Square words it as the start of Chapter 2.||

blocks.text: Side work:
Two Key Lento regulars with work outside the main story: Cal's drinks and fishing, and Kenton's dive sites.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Kenton: 5 of 7 sets and all 33 underwater discoveries; Cal's fishing challenges count as optional tasks||

blocks.title: Ring the Bell! (Cal)
blocks.text: ||Cal texts after Day Release while Jason drives to meet Brian for Swamped. At the Rusty Anchor, have a drink with Cal (the shots blur the screen), choose Give Ride Home, get him to the car and drive him home. Declining twice or walking away ends it with nothing. Reward: the White Rusty Anchor T-Shirt and Rusty Anchor Cap can be bought.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason following Cal into the Rusty Anchor

blocks.title: Driving Cal home
blocks.text: ||GTABase says the bar shirt and cap can only be bought if he gets home with you. It is missable and only offered in Chapter 1; GTABase's page disagrees with itself on whether it counts for 100%.||
blocks.frameAlt: A car pulling into the driveway of a stilt house

blocks.title: Catch A Bigger Fish (Cal)
blocks.text: ||Cal texts after Feng Shui. Take a boat (the fishing boats by the Rusty Anchor), drop anchor from the vehicle menu, and catch a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lb in Gambit Bay with the basic Small Saltwater Lure; press X or A to send it to Cal. Reward: a Focus increase and the Baited My Tackle trophy. If missed, it comes back later.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason holding up a colourful parrotfish

blocks.title: Cal's other fishing challenges
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx's 100% guide counts Cal's fishing challenges toward the 100 optional tasks.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason reeling in on a boat while Cal looks through binoculars

blocks.title: Kenton's dive sites
blocks.text: ||Kenton, met in Island Dreams, also runs treasure dives (Search the Dive Sites in PowerPyx's list). PowerPyx says they pause when Chapter 1 ends, Kenton returns between Chapters 2 and 3, and the jobs stay open after the story. The sets and finds are covered in the collectibles guide.||
Side work:
Kirk hunts the Skunk Ape. His three jobs count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy, and two need the night.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Read one of his flyers, then call him from Contacts||
||Night only for the first and last jobs; sleep to skip ahead||

blocks.title: Finding Kirk
blocks.text: ||His Skunk Ape flyers hang in public places; PowerPyx names Skeeter's bar in Hamlet. Reading one is the trigger: then call Kirk from your phone contacts. Either lead can start the first two jobs.||

blocks.title: Search for the Skunk Ape (Skunk Apeology 101)
blocks.text: ||Call Kirk at night, follow the drone, investigate the sound and search the area: the feeding site in the middle and the claw marks just east of it. Inspect the tree effigy at the forest edge and return to the truck. Reward: $1,000.||

blocks.title: Search for Tree Effigies
blocks.text: ||Kirk texts and marks a large search area in the Pelican Valley swamps. Find the 3 effigies in any order; it ends by itself after the third.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason beside a branch effigy tied to a mangrove tree

blocks.title: Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove (Advanced Skunk Apeonomics)
blocks.text: ||A text a few days later, from Chapter 2 on, for Lucia only and at night, at Cottonmouth Lake. Hunt, search, pick up, find flies, find Kirk, then make the last choice. Reward: the Mister Mangrove Laird 350 tranquilliser rifle; one of the three choices also pays $10,000. Every outcome completes the strand.||
blocks.frameAlt: Kirk lit by a flashlight in the dark swamp

blocks.text: Side work:
A farmer near the Starlet Motel. Three jobs from Chapter 2 into Chapter 3, all counting toward Strangers & Freaks.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Read the flyer outside the Starlet Motel reception||
||Strangers & Freaks: yes, whichever way the last choice goes||

blocks.title: Finding Kyle
blocks.text: ||Read the flyer by the Starlet Motel reception door in Chapter 2. Reading it starts the first job, Check Out McKittrick Farm. Either lead can play all three.||

blocks.title: Check Out McKittrick Farm
blocks.text: ||When Kyle lands at the airstrip, accept his request, get in the crop duster, take off, dust over Kyle, land on the runway and speak to him. Reward: $400.||

blocks.title: Collect Chemicals for Kyle
blocks.text: ||A text about a day later marks a compound in Leonard County. Talk to the woman at the gate and inspect the chemicals in the white van. Paying $5,000 is called a waste; refusing starts a fight, then take the van, wedge the gate open with another car if needed and escape a two-star wanted level. Reward: $1,000, and the strawberries at the farm can be eaten.||

blocks.title: Buddy? (Check on Kyle)
blocks.text: ||Kyle texts in Chapter 3, which can take a long time. Search McKittrick Farm and choose an ending: siding with the police pays $5,000 through BuckMe, the other pays nothing. Both finish the strand.||
Side work:
Moses in Port Gellhorn buys older cars without trackers. After Daily Driver he sends a list of six, one at a time, with a gift at the end.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Each delivery is an optional task, and counts toward the $200,000 of fenced vehicles||

blocks.title: How the list works
blocks.text: ||Moses gives each car only after the last is delivered to his shop. Each pays a set amount plus a bonus for good condition. He will not take cars stolen near the garage.||

blocks.title: The awkward ones
blocks.text: ||The Yosemite is on a tow truck: knock out the driver and lower it off the hook. The Futo is in a garage at the Draper Island docks; park before the gates and hop the fences. The Bandito seats one, so send your partner away first.||

blocks.title: The Vamos shed
blocks.text: ||North-east of Grayson. The shed code is 2727, written on signs inside the main trailer; use the button on the right to open it. Locals may try to block the road back.||

blocks.title: The Nightblade
blocks.text: ||At the Final Chapter clubhouse in Ambrosia. Bring armour and a long gun; for stealth climb the green container north of the fence. It is the orange bike on the lower floor of the central garage.||

blocks.title: Collect Moses' Gift
blocks.text: ||Once all six are in, Moses texts. Open the smaller garage beside his main one and take Moses' Sultan, a unique street racer you can keep or sell.||

blocks.caption: Moses' list, in order
rows: ||South-west Port Gellhorn, on a tow truck||
||Garage on the west end, south edge of Draper Island||
||Driveway on Orchard Avenue, south Port Gellhorn||

blocks.text: Side work:
Jason's old army friend runs a hunting business in Lummox County. One mission, then fifteen hunting orders.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||A text to Jason some time after Coffee Break||
||Jason alone; Lucia cannot be with him||

blocks.title: Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)
blocks.text: ||Ride in Bret's truck to the woods, follow the scent trail with L3 + R3, study the deer, shoot it, carry the carcass to his truck and unload it in the processing area at the cabin. Reward: $500 and the Killtelligence SM-69, which waits in any Ammu-Nation locker.||

blocks.title: Clean kills pay more
blocks.text: ||A single head or heart shot keeps an animal pristine, which pays more; extra shots lower its quality. Pristine is not required.||

blocks.title: Bret's Hunting Decks
blocks.text: ||Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons. Hunt the animal he asks for and bring it to him as Jason. Progress is under Map, Activities, Target Deck.||

blocks.title: Fair Game and the full set
blocks.text: ||Hunting a unique animal for Bret gives the Fair Game trophy. All 15 decks are on the 100% list, and they stay open after the story.||

items: ||Which animal triggers Fair Game; PowerPyx was still confirming it.||
||Whether Bret's strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.||

blocks.text: Side work:
Billy runs the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five jobs from Chapter 2 to Chapter 3, ending with a trophy.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Not Strangers & Freaks; The Lone Rider trophy at the end||
||Mall Rats must be started by one lead alone||

blocks.title: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club)
blocks.text: ||Buy outfits at the merch stall, rent a bike at Roostere's Rentals (the dearer Sanchez is faster) and race Billy's crew. You only need to beat last place. First place pays up to $2,500.||
blocks.frameAlt: A night dirt bike race on the Mud Club track

blocks.title: Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (Join Billy on a Job)
blocks.text: ||Sit on the marked bench in Port Gellhorn and wait. Follow Billy on the dirt bike, chase the armoured van until it hits a tree, blow the rear doors, deal with the guard and ride up the mountain. Reward: $2,000.||

blocks.title: Mall Rats
blocks.text: ||Chapter 3, Ocean Beach, alone. Follow Billy, rob the jewellery store (blow the back safe or wait for Billy to get the code), follow him and get in the back of the van. Reward: $12,000.||
blocks.frameAlt: A dirt bike parked in front of an ice-cream truck

blocks.title: The Impaler (Steal the Impaler)
blocks.text: ||Reply to Wyman's text a few days after Mall Rats. Take the Police Impaler from the Ambrosia police impound past its two guards, lose the police by following the train tracks into the tunnel and leave it at the marked spot. No reward.||
blocks.frameAlt: The low brick Ambrosia police building behind a car park

blocks.title: Hometown Heroes
blocks.text: ||Billy texts a few days later; it starts at the Mud Club and needs both leads. Ram rivals on the raceway, loot the safe, protect Billy, then go to the sugar factory and escape the building. Reward: $10,000 and The Lone Rider trophy.||
Side work:
A street racer in Little Cuba and Salton. Four jobs for Jason; one is on a timer and can be missed.

blocks.caption: What you need

blocks.title: Join a Street Race
blocks.text: ||In Salton, rent one of three cars ($600 to $900; the dearest is best) and finish the race. First pays $3,000.||

blocks.title: Bumper to Bumper (Mentor Yago)
blocks.text: ||Appears in Little Cuba after a long wait; if it shows a lock, sleep and come back in the afternoon or evening. At the mod shop apply Pro Builds, Full Kits, Custom Street Racing Build and Performance, Boost, Nitrous Boost (Yago pays), then race, lose the police and drive to the meet. Reward: $500.||
blocks.frameAlt: Yago in a white vest gesturing in a garage

blocks.title: Race Against Yago
blocks.text: ||Marked with an hourglass: do it as soon as it appears. Talk to Santiago, pick the second race, Freeway Run, rent a car and race. First pays $3,800.||
blocks.frameAlt: A wrapped street-race hatchback under an overpass

blocks.title: Brother to Brother (Back Up Yago)
blocks.text: ||After another wait, use the back door of El Rincon Notorio in Little Cuba. Drive to the deal in west Vice City, follow Manuel, pick up the bag, fight back to the car and follow Yago. Reward: Yago's car, and the strand counts.||
blocks.frameAlt: Yago in a white vest at the wheel of a car

blocks.title: Missable
items: ||Race Against Yago is time-limited. GTABase also marks it missable. If it lapses, the strand may not finish; no guide says whether Brother to Brother still opens.||

blocks.text: Side work:
Andy, who handed over Lucia's clothes in Chapter 1, draws Lucia into the Cellerica group in Chapter 3. Five jobs, Lucia only.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Andy calls Lucia after Mami Knows Best and Car Service||
||Not Strangers & Freaks; Road to Rehabilitation trophy||

blocks.title: Climbing the Cellerichain
blocks.text: ||Three parts from Andy's house in Belville. Take the welcome kit and deliver a package to a backyard in Waning Sands; photograph Andy and deliver to the Cellerica stall in northern Vice City; take the package from the garage (a magazine is nearby) to a home in Ambrosia. Refusing the junkie in Part 3 is easier. Reward: Pure Manifestick and a Cellerica Cap.||

blocks.title: Pay the Cellerica Fee
blocks.text: ||Andy calls; pay $5,000 in BuckMe.||

blocks.title: Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation)
blocks.text: ||Sit on the bench in Belville. Follow Andy, change, take part in the initiation (always using the vape stick and defusing things impresses Cecilia; misbehaving earns a Peach), then drive the golf cart to Cecilia's mansion.||

blocks.title: Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van)
blocks.text: ||In north Vice City, knock out the two men and drive the van to the yellow spot at the Belville warehouse. Reward: $1,800 through BuckMe.||

blocks.title: Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse)
blocks.text: ||Starts at Cecilia's mansion: follow Felix, escape the warehouse and go back to the mansion. Reward: $10,000, the $5,000 fee back, and the Road to Rehabilitation trophy.||
Side work:
Yasmani in Little Cuba buys jewellery and marked bills and sells robbery tips. His jobs lead from shop safes to bank vaults.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Snap Gun from the first jewellery delivery; Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check; a car with a winch for ATMs||
||Not Strangers & Freaks; the 8 vaults are on the 100% list||

blocks.caption: Jewellery safe codes

blocks.title: Casa de Empeno
blocks.text: ||Do it first: no back door, so the Snap Gun is not needed. The buffalo skull chain is in the safe in the small back office, code 1680. Wipe the footage at the security box left of the safe. Smashing the cases adds jewellery.||

blocks.title: Richardson Jewelry
blocks.text: ||Snap Gun the back door. Disarm security at the panel right of the door to the central room, wipe the footage at the box under the screen, and open the safe in the north-east corner, code 6815, for the diamond ring.||

blocks.title: Donovan Banks & Co.
blocks.text: ||Snap Gun the back door; footage and alarm are both in the small back office. The amethyst necklace is in the safe halfway along the long back hallway, code 0104. Sell all three to Yasmani: $20,000 plus extras.||

blocks.title: ATM and Payday Loans jobs
blocks.text: ||ATMs hold marked bills in cases you shoot open; pull the machine out of the wall with a car fitted with a winch. Payday Loans stores open after Credit Check; there are 7, all on the 100% list. PowerPyx says two Payday Loans jobs must be done before Yasmani sells van tips.||

blocks.title: That's Where The Money Is... (the first vault)
blocks.text: ||After VCIA Takedown. Sit by the window at Cafe Orquidea, tail the van, follow the guard inside, mask up and plant explosives on the back doorway. Clear the vault guards and take the marked bills from the cart, passing a full bag to your partner. Four stars at once and no back door: leave by the front, swap cars in a car park and change into a hat and glasses. Sell to Yasmani: about $80,000.||

blocks.title: Tail the Security Van
blocks.text: ||Afterwards Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000; the van gets a purple icon and leads to a bank. A vault pays up to $205,000. All 8 vaults are needed for 100%; the robberies chapter covers each bank.||

items: ||PowerPyx's fence guide says vault robberies open in Chapter 5; its other guides tie them to That's Where The Money Is... at the end of Chapter 4.||

blocks.text: Side work:
Randy in Balsero buys high-end cars stolen with the Key Cloner. His Wish List is one long job that stays open after the story.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Car Service (cars with Standard Trackers); Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (the Wish List)||
||A green RK icon in the west of Vice City||
||Supply & Demand trophy; each delivery is an optional task||

blocks.title: Get the Key Cloner
blocks.text: ||Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS installs it for both leads and delivers the first car. After it, follow Randy to the board to see the Wish List.||

blocks.title: Find the cars
blocks.text: ||The list is under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. Randy marks some at fixed spots, or gives tips one at a time, but any matching car counts. Scan with WAiNK to check; PowerPyx says they often turn up around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.||

blocks.title: Deliver in good shape
blocks.text: ||Advanced trackers report you to the police if you drive too slowly. Cars in perfect condition pay more, about $35,000 or more for a sports car.||

blocks.title: Supply & Demand
blocks.text: ||Finishing the list gives the trophy. Deliveries also help toward the $200,000 of fenced vehicles on the 100% list.||

items: ||How many cars are on the list: PowerPyx's trophy guide names 16, its money guide says 18.||

blocks.text: Side work:
Tyrone in La Perle pays to have Kitty Litter labs destroyed, then leads one big raid.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Not Strangers & Freaks; each lab is an optional task; Spin On This! trophy||

blocks.title: How it starts
blocks.text: ||Tyrone brings the labs up in Here, Kitty Kitty, after which you are prompted to destroy them. Dook and Tyrone hand out locations. The labs never close: they can still be done after the story.||

blocks.title: Take Out Kitty Litter
blocks.text: ||Purple search areas mark the labs. Find the building giving off pink gas and destroy the equipment: shoot a propane canister or throw a Molotov in. Cooks you intimidate may give another location. Pay: $2,000 or $2,500 per lab through BuckMe.||

blocks.title: Where they are
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx's areas: the story lab, three in Balsero, one in central Rockridge, three in Crosstown (one behind Cross My Heart Tattoos), and one each in the Decor District, Little Cuba, Salton, Tequesta (upper floor of the C-shaped motel) and Vice-Dale.||

blocks.title: Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs)
blocks.text: ||Opens after enough labs. As Jason, go to the diner outside Grayson, then the motel; take out the guard at the green door quietly, break into the lab, clear it, plant explosives on the vats, fight off reinforcements and chase Rocky through the pipe. Reward: $10,000 and the Spin On This! trophy.||

items: ||How many labs there are: PowerPyx says 14 but lists 13.||
||How many labs open Spin On This.||

blocks.text: Side work:
Dunk in Port Gellhorn is a fence from Chapter 2 and passes on robbery tips. Guides have little on his tips so far.

blocks.caption: What you need

blocks.title: Dunk as a fence
blocks.text: ||After Slam Dunk, Dunk buys stolen goods at his trailer in Port Gellhorn. PowerPyx says he is unavailable for part of the story but back afterwards.||

blocks.title: The first tips
blocks.text: ||The day after Slam Dunk he calls and marks two robbery locations on the map.||

blocks.title: Selling to Dunk
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx sends the loot from Hit Avery Pawn to Dunk's trailer in Port Gellhorn; drop the bag there for cash.||

blocks.title: Dunk's Robbery Tips
blocks.text: ||Listed as Dunk's only Chapter 3 job in PowerPyx's side mission list. Its magazines guide mentions a trailer area in Lost Vista, Port Gellhorn, as one place he marks.||

items: ||How many tips Dunk gives and whether they count toward Strangers & Freaks.||

blocks.text: Side work:
Met at the Y Hotel pool bar in Pool Day. One party, one choice, and nothing to gain but a story.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||A text a few days after Pool Day||

blocks.title: The invitation
blocks.text: ||You meet Eddie at the pool bar during Pool Day; accepting or declining his invite makes no difference. A few days later he texts an invitation to a party in Heathcliff Heights, and the mission is marked at the Y Hotel.||

blocks.title: Go to the party
blocks.text: ||Go with one lead only; your partner cannot come. Attend the party and meet Eddie at the lift.||

blocks.title: The offer
blocks.text: ||Paying costs $50,000 and gets you a worthless NFT picture. Refusing costs nothing.||

blocks.title: Getting off the roof
blocks.text: ||If you refuse or shoot (his door is bulletproof), ride the bike over the solar panels at full speed and take the lift on the other roof. In the lobby you can intimidate him and he runs out.||
Side work:
Pete's smuggling runs for Jason in Chapter 4. Five flights, all counting toward Strangers & Freaks, four of them against the clock.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Red circles on the map: flying into them brings a wanted level||

blocks.title: The Last Mile: Passing the Torch (Recover Pete's Plane)
blocks.text: ||At Sundown Private Airfield, open the safe in the hangar back room with code 3718, take Pete's plane, drop at the three marked sites and land at the airstrip south of Port Gellhorn. Reward: $12,000.||

blocks.title: The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot (Deliver Packages)
blocks.text: ||About half a day later. Land the seaplane near the supplier at Wild Hog Airfield, drop all 7 packages within 2 hours and fly back to the hangar. Reward: $20,000 if all arrive in time.||

blocks.title: Pete's Deliveries: Southpoint Airfield
