chapters.title: Cards, Scans and Stunts
chapters.intro: Collectible cards, WAiNK landmarks, curiosities and sculptures, Under the Bridge, stunt jumps and base jumps: what counts, how to do each, and every location the launch guides have published.

blocks.text: Cards, scans

This chapter covers five things the 100% checklist counts: collectible cards, WAiNK scans of landmarks, curiosities and sculptures, Under the Bridge flights, stunt jumps and base jumps. Each has its own page with the locations the launch guides have published so far.

blocks.caption: What counts toward 100%
rows: ||31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags||
||397: 130 stunt jumps, 202 Under the Bridge, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps||

blocks.title: Where the game keeps count
blocks.text: ||Cards are under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards; scans under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations; stunts under Progress, Activities, Stunts, where pressing R3 on a kind shows progress by region. PowerPyx says the 100% figure itself shows in the 100% checklist once the story is done.||

blocks.title: Stunts show on the map by name
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx says every stunt has its own name and stays on the map once found. Open the map, choose Exploration (the magnifying glass), then Stunt Spots: found stunts are listed in purple and completed ones in white.||

blocks.title: The 89 here are not enough for You WAiNKer!
blocks.text: ||Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures add up to 89. The other 11 or more of the 100 have to come from another WAiNK kind, such as the No Flusher tags, which PowerPyx counts at 23. AHOL street art and the 1010 murals are scanned the same way but do not count.||

blocks.title: Cards: you can skip three sets
blocks.text: ||The checklist asks for 15 of the 18 sets. PowerPyx puts the minimum at 372 of the 480 cards, which is what is left after leaving out three of the 36-card sets (480 minus 3 times 36).||

blocks.title: Stunts: start with the bridges
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx and GTABase both call Under the Bridge the quickest stunts. All 202 bridges plus 98 of the other 195 stunts make 300; all 202 bridges plus the 25 base jumps leave 73 stunt jumps or knife flights to find.||
blocks.frameAlt: A seaplane flying low over wooded islands and a long bridge in the Leonida Keys

blocks.title: Challenges and cheats along the way
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx lists an Exploration challenge for 3 cards in each of the 5 counties and one for any 4 landmarks, curiosities or sculptures. Its cheats guide ties three cheats to this chapter: Unlimited Nitrous for 50 stunt jumps, Bubblegum for all 24 Vice City Flamingos cards, and Powdered Sugar for scanning all space debris with WAiNK.||

blocks.caption: ||A suggested order, built from the sources on each page||
steps: ||Chapter 1 to 2: pick up the Key Lento cards and the two missable Starlet Motel cards||
||As soon as you can fly: take a seaplane or helicopter from Southwind and work up the Under the Bridge list||
||Buy a parachute and clear the 22 city base jumps from rooftop helipads||
||Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures on foot as you pass them||
||Finish with stunt jumps by motorbike until the total reaches 300||

items: ||The guides were still being written on 21 November. Most card locations and many WAiNK spots have not been published by a source this app may use; the tables say how many are known for each set.||
||Per-jump bonus challenges and directions for each stunt jump have not been published by an allowed source.||

blocks.text: Collectible cards:

Cards lie around Leonida inside and outside buildings. This page covers how to pick them up, track them, sell them and plan the 15 sets the checklist needs. The next three pages list every published spot.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||GTA Wiki says cards are available after this Chapter 1 mission.||
A way to break open safes and doors
||Some cards sit in safes or locked rooms; GTA BOOM uses Break Open on a safe.||
||PowerPyx and Push Square each send you through a container or door that needs one.||
||Several Permit Keys and Abismo Key cards are on small islands (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Spot the card
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx says cards indoors sit on surfaces or are stuck to walls; outdoors they are usually in yellow phone boxes on walls or in tool boxes. Cards cannot be bought, so the number is fixed.||
blocks.frameAlt: A Collectible Card prompt on the sand beside a campfire and a folding chair at night

blocks.title: Pick it up
blocks.text: ||GTA BOOM says to use the Collectible Card prompt. A card in a safe needs Break Open (Triangle or Y): move the right stick until the circle fills faster, then hold it there.||

blocks.title: Check the set
blocks.text: ||Open Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. GTA BOOM says the first card of a set reveals that set in the menu. PowerPyx and Push Square list each set in the same order as that menu, which is the order of the numbers in the tables.||

blocks.title: Colours count separately
blocks.text: ||Many cards come in colour versions (Bronze, Silver, Gold, or colours such as Red, Blue and Purple), and PowerPyx says each counts as its own card. A card found twice is only a duplicate to sell.||

blocks.title: Sell at a pawn shop
blocks.text: ||Cards sell at pawn shops for about $20 to more than $1,000, depending on rarity (PowerPyx). Push Square says to find a shop that takes cards from the map under Exploration, Collectors, Pawn Shops, and that kept cards can be viewed in a wooden box at the apartment. Both say a sold card still counts toward the set.||

blocks.title: Random cards in yellow containers
blocks.text: ||Push Square says random cards also turn up in yellow containers around Leonida and count toward progress, but cannot be listed because they are random. It is still checking whether shiny cards have several spawn spots.||

blocks.text: Under the
Fly a plane or helicopter under a bridge without crashing. There are 202, the largest stunt kind, and PowerPyx calls them the quickest. Any mix of 300 stunts counts for 100%.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||A Buckingham Maverick on the dock at Southwind, east of the car park by the Sherwin Boatworks sign (PC Gamer); helipads marked H on the map, many on Vice City rooftops reached by lift (PowerPyx).||
||Mammoth Dodo seaplanes at the hangar in Southwind (PC Gamer); crop dusters at airstrips, which PowerPyx says carry plenty of fuel and do not bring fighter jets after you.||
||A plane that runs out of fuel crashes. PowerPyx says to land at the nearest airstrip for another when the gauge turns yellow.||

blocks.title: Get an aircraft
blocks.text: ||PC Gamer's first helicopter is on the dock at Southwind, about 2.5 miles south-west of Jason's house along Sunbelt Highway, past two long bridges. Ignore the no-trespassing sign and take it. PowerPyx warns that jets taken from VCIA carry trackers and bring a wanted level and fighter jets.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason at an open gate looking out to a dock where a yellow helicopter sits

blocks.title: Find the next bridge
blocks.text: ||Bridges stay marked on the map by name once found: Map, Exploration, Stunt Spots. GTABase lists all 202 with a map area; the table below follows its order, which starts in the Keys and works north.||

blocks.title: Line up low and slow
blocks.text: ||Fly under the span without touching it. GTABase says many are meant for a plane or helicopter, and that the low bridges over Vice City's canals and rivers take a steady hand; a helicopter can stop and line up where a plane cannot.||
blocks.frameAlt: Traffic on a causeway across the water toward the Vice City skyline

blocks.title: Check it counted
blocks.text: ||Under Progress, Activities, Stunts, press R3 on Under the Bridge for progress by region (PowerPyx). Challenges shown on the map icon are optional; flying under once counts.||

blocks.title: Keys and Watson Bay first
blocks.text: ||Entries 1 to 41 in the table are in GTABase's Key Lento, Hamlet, Gloriana Key and Watson Bay areas, close to the Southwind aircraft. Swap to a fresh aircraft at an airstrip when fuel runs low (PowerPyx).||
blocks.frameAlt: Seaplanes parked on a concrete apron by the water at Southwind

blocks.title: Rewards
blocks.text: ||Bridges count toward Cunning Stunts (250 stunts) and the 300 for 100%. No separate reward for bridges alone has been published.||

blocks.text: Stunt
130 named ramps, rooftops and gaps to jump with a car or bike: 55 in Vice-Dale County, 29 in Kelly, 17 in Mariana, 16 in Lummox and 13 in Leonard.

blocks.text: ||Each jump has a unique name and stays on the map once found. Hover over its map icon to see its small challenge (PowerPyx).||

blocks.title: Hit it with speed
blocks.text: ||Line up with the ramp and take it fast. PowerPyx and GTABase say making the jump is enough; the challenge is not needed for 100%.||

blocks.title: Rewards

blocks.text: Base
Twenty-five parachute jumps from high points: 22 from Vice City rooftops and masts, one in Kelly County and two on Mount Kalaga.
On the map: 1 base jumps

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Ammu-Nation: the first store in Key Lento has parachutes on the back left wall, or ask the clerk under Equipment (PowerPyx). PC Gamer says Ammu-Nations that sell clothes (shirt icon) stock them, some skyscraper roofs have a box of parachutes, and there is one at the top of the tallest peak in Mount Kalaga National Park.||
||Lifts in tower lobbies reach the rooftop helipads (PowerPyx); a helicopter does the rest.||

blocks.title: Buy and equip the parachute
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx says to select it on the item wheel and switch it on; it shares a slot with body armour, so switch over if armour is on. It is then worn unseen and ready for any long fall.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia in an Ammu-Nation in front of a wall rack of parachute bags

blocks.title: Get to the top
blocks.text: ||Base jumps are always high up: radio masts, rooftops and mountains (PowerPyx). Most of the 22 in Vice-Dale County are named after towers, hotels and apartment blocks; take the lift to the roof.||
blocks.frameAlt: Tall Vice City towers against a clear sky

blocks.title: Jump and open the chute
blocks.text: ||Jump off and press the button shown on screen to open the parachute. PC Gamer says you steer left and right, angle down to drop faster and pull back to slow down.||

blocks.title: Fly through the rings
blocks.text: ||Each base jump has you steer through a set of rings (PowerPyx). Finishing with any time counts for 100%; beating the par time is not needed.||

blocks.title: Re-arm before the next jump
blocks.text: ||PC Gamer says you buy the parachute once but may need to reset it between jumps: pick it from the rack at a gun store again, or re-equip one found on a skyscraper roof.||

blocks.title: Mount Kalaga last
blocks.text: ||The two Lummox County jumps are Mount Kalaga and Kalaga Outcrop (PowerPyx); PC Gamer says a parachute waits at the top of the tallest peak in the park.||
blocks.frameAlt: A road winding between steep wooded hills in Mount Kalaga National Park

blocks.title: Rewards
blocks.text: ||Base jumps count toward Cunning Stunts (250) and the 300 for 100%. PowerPyx says 50 skydives or base jumps from 300 feet or higher unlock the Parachute cheat.||

blocks.caption: All 25 base jumps (PowerPyx's numbers and counties, GTABase's map areas)

blocks.text: ||Jumps 2 to 8 sit in GTABase's Gloriana Key area and 9 to 19 in its Vice City area. A helicopter from a rooftop helipad can hop between towers, and PC Gamer says rooftop parachute boxes let you re-equip without a trip to Ammu-Nation.||

chapters.title: Collectibles, Part B
chapters.intro: Basketball hoops, meditation, reading, book swaps, Kenton's wrecks, meteorites, cocaine flamingos, knife flights, No Flusher tags, street art, styles, playlists and Wyman's cars: what counts, how to do each, where the guides place them and what they earn. Nearly all of it comes from guides written in launch week, so details stay covered until you choose to see spoilers.

blocks.text: Part B at a

Hoops, quiet spots, reading, treasure, and the scans and art that sit outside WAiNK's main hundred. Each collection has its own page: what counts, how to do it, where the guides place it and what it earns. Part A covers the cards, the main WAiNK kinds, Under the Bridge, stunt jumps and base jumps.

blocks.title: Where the game keeps count
blocks.text: ||Push Square says the 100% checklist stays hidden until the story is finished, then sits under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Most Part B collections are tracked under Progress, Collections, Exploration, and PowerPyx says some groups only appear there once you have found one item in them.||

blocks.title: Clear Jason's house in Chapter 1
blocks.text: ||Five reading items in Jason's house and the meditation with Lucia on his balcony can only be had during Chapter 1 (PowerPyx, Push Square, GTABase). None is needed for 100 percent, since the checklist asks for 30 of 34 readings and 15 of 18 meditations, and PowerPyx says the books can be found elsewhere too. PowerPyx was not sure whether that meditation counts toward Positive Mental Attitude, so doing it is the safe choice.||

blocks.title: Start diving early
blocks.text: ||Treasure diving opens with the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams (PowerPyx, GTABase). PowerPyx says Kenton is away for a while after Chapter 1, so the first wrecks are best done before then.||

blocks.title: The rest can wait
blocks.text: ||GTABase says nothing on the 100% checklist is missable and everything can be finished in free roam after the story; PowerPyx says missable content does not affect trophies or 100 percent. Pick Part B up as you pass through each county rather than in one long sweep.||

blocks.title: What pays
blocks.text: ||Flamingo cocaine sells to a fence and counts toward the $100,000 of narcotics the checklist wants (PowerPyx). Kenton buys treasure (Push Square, GTA BOOM). The guides list no cash for the other Part B collections.||

blocks.title: Pick up the ball and shoot
blocks.text: ||Push Square gives the PlayStation controls: L1 picks up the ball, L2 aims and R2 throws. The angle and distance of the shot decide how hard it is.||

blocks.text: ||Only a basket counts, not a throw near the hoop (Push Square). Scoring again at the same hoop adds nothing: the checklist wants 90 different hoops (GTABase).||

blocks.title: What a hoop gives
blocks.text: ||Push Square says each hoop scored permanently raises Jason's and Lucia's Focus. One scored hoop also ticks the basketball box of Master of None, the bronze trophy for trying each kind of activity once (PowerPyx).||

blocks.title: Basketball challenges
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx lists Sports challenges for scoring at three hoops in a day, ten shots in a row, a hoop in every county and all 100 hoops.||

blocks.text: Meditation
Ten quiet places to sit and breathe. Most of them count twice, once for each lead.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Jason and Lucia; both are playable after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (PowerPyx)||
||15 of 18 for 100%; every spot for Positive Mental Attitude||
||Purple icons that appear when you are close; filter Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida (PowerPyx)||

blocks.title: Jason's house, Chapter 1 only
blocks.text: ||The morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen of Jason's house and follow her out to the balcony. An optional quest notice appears; focus on Lucia and accept, and she shows Jason how to meditate (GTABase). It is only there in Chapter 1 and counts as one of the 18.||

blocks.title: Breathe with the triggers
blocks.text: ||Once seated, use L2 and R2 to breathe in and out slowly, filling the two meters steadily (Push Square). The on-screen prompt reads Hold L2 and R2 to breathe in deeply.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason meditating cross-legged on a dock at sunset, with the L2 and R2 breathing meters on screen

blocks.title: Get back in the zone
blocks.text: ||When concentration slips, move the left and right sticks back into the sweet spot. Push Square says it usually takes about two rounds of this.||

blocks.title: Wait for the calm ending
blocks.text: ||A meditation only counts once its closing zen animation has played (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Do each spot twice
blocks.text: ||Each of the eight middle spots counts once for Jason and once for Lucia, which makes 16; Jason's house and Ascent Mountain count once each, for 18 (PowerPyx). GTABase counts 10 spots and 18 meditations the same way.||

blocks.title: Ascent Mountain comes last
blocks.text: ||The stone circle at the peak of Mount Kalaga only appears once every other meditation is done, and a map notice tells you when (PowerPyx).||

blocks.title: What it earns
blocks.text: ||Positive Mental Attitude, a bronze trophy, for meditating at every spot (Push Square). TheSixthAxis's review says meditation raises Focus. Push Square and PowerPyx both tie the Fast Forward screen filter cheat to 50 meditations, more than the 18 that exist.||

blocks.title: Clear Jason's house first
blocks.text: ||Five are in Jason's house in Key Lento: Ashes of Glory by the bed, Lethal By Design and Orca on the living-room tables, Body Copy on the back deck by the weights, and Off the Hook in the shed underneath (PowerPyx, Push Square). Read them before Chapter 1 ends.||

blocks.text: ||PowerPyx says the missable titles can also be found in other places. The Big Lead names some: Off the Hook in a trailer south of the Port Gellhorn stash house, Orca on a table in the tiki bar south of Southwind, and Remote Strike behind the closed bar east of Southwind.||

blocks.text: Kenton's
Wreck diving for Kenton Rees in the Leonida Keys, with a metal detector, a speargun and a boat.
On the map: 3 kenton's treasure

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Island Dreams, a Chapter 1 mission, after Hey Arnold! (PowerPyx)||
||Scuba gear, which brings the metal detector and the Arras Bullhead speargun (GTA BOOM)||

blocks.title: Island Dreams
blocks.text: ||Talk to Kenton at his Island Dreams shop by the beach in Key Lento, drive the boat to the marked spot, put on the yellow scuba gear at the back and dive to the wreck (PowerPyx, GTABase). The mission pays $400 (PowerPyx) and unlocks underwater treasure hunting (GTABase).||
blocks.frameAlt: Kenton's dive boat heading out to sea with a party of divers on the rear deck

blocks.title: Gear up
blocks.text: ||At the stern of the stopped charter boat, use the Scuba Gear prompt; it adds the metal detector and the Arras Bullhead speargun, and a second set waits on the dock (GTA BOOM). Push Square says the gear can be put on at Island Dreams or aboard the boat.||
blocks.frameAlt: Kenton's charter boat at its dock in Key Lento, with the prompt to go to the diving spot

blocks.title: Dive
blocks.text: ||Hold R1/RB to dive and press X/A to surface; the green bar at the top left is your oxygen (GTA BOOM, GTABase).||
blocks.frameAlt: Divers swimming down through an underwater trench

blocks.title: Sweep with the metal detector
blocks.text: ||Pick the metal detector from the weapon wheel and aim it with L2/LT. Swim the marked search area until its light turns from red to green, then follow it to a gold icon on the seabed (PowerPyx, GTABase, GTA BOOM). If the signal is lost, Push Square says turn the camera slowly until it beeps again; GTA BOOM says sweep the wreck's edge rather than the whole circle.||
blocks.frameAlt: A diver holding the metal detector over the sandy seabed, with the prompt to swim closer while keeping the signal

blocks.title: Take the find
blocks.text: ||A loose find is taken with Triangle/Y at a Treasure prompt; a chest has an Open prompt. A chest stuck in the sand needs L2 and R2 (LT and RT) held, then X/A tapped to pull it free. At Del Ocio the last find is a Search dig in the sand (GTA BOOM).||
blocks.frameAlt: A diver over the sand with the Search prompt and the hint to hold L2 or R2 to find a signal

blocks.title: Sell to Kenton
blocks.text: ||At his counter, hold L2/LT to focus on Kenton and choose Treasures; the prompt shows the payout first. GTA BOOM was offered $200 for one chest find. Push Square says single items fetch little and a finished set pays much more later.||
blocks.frameAlt: Kenton Rees reaching out a hand, in a frame from Rockstar's own footage

blocks.title: The next three wrecks
blocks.text: ||Clearing La Noche, Ética Laxa and Del Ocio brings Kenton's next job: go back to the shop and he texts three more wrecks, picked by name under Search the Dive Sites on the map (GTA BOOM). PowerPyx says Kenton is away for a while after Chapter 1.||

blocks.title: Underwater Discoveries
blocks.text: ||All 33 are on the checklist. PowerPyx ties them to Kenton's shipwrecks and gives no separate list; GTABase says all seven Kenton sets are needed for them, while Push Square marks two of the seven sites as not counting. The Exploration challenges ask for 25 Underwater Discoveries, 85 underwater treasures and all 11 black hole wrecks (PowerPyx).||

blocks.title: Finish the job
blocks.text: ||Kenton's final mission earns the bronze trophy This Was No Boat Accident (Push Square); PowerPyx says he wants seven wrecks cleared in all.||

blocks.title: Take the cocaine

blocks.title: Sell it to a fence
blocks.text: ||The cocaine sells to a fence. Selling it is not needed for the flamingo count, but it feeds the checklist's $100,000 of narcotics fenced (PowerPyx).||

blocks.title: Fifty for a cheat
blocks.text: ||Breaking 50 unlocks the Inflatable Flamingo spawn cheat (Push Square, PowerPyx). Cheats only work after the story, and using one switches off trophies and saving (PowerPyx).||

blocks.text: Knife
Forty narrow gaps between buildings, flown by aeroplane. They are one of the four kinds of stunt.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||An aircraft: knife flights are flying stunts between buildings (PowerPyx, GTABase)||
||Part of 300 of 397 stunts for 100%; 250 for Cunning Stunts||
||Progress, Activities, Stunts; on the map, Exploration, Stunt Spots (GTABase)||

blocks.title: What counts
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx and GTABase list 40 knife flights, one of four stunt kinds alongside stunt jumps, Under the Bridges and base jumps, and describe them as flying between buildings.||

blocks.title: Find them on the map
blocks.text: ||Stunts are tracked by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and by name on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots (GTABase). For stunt jumps, PowerPyx says found stunts show purple and completed ones white.||

blocks.title: Once is enough
blocks.text: ||A stunt counts the first time you complete it; the extra challenge shown on each map icon is optional (GTABase, PowerPyx).||

blocks.title: Mix the kinds
blocks.text: ||The 300 for the checklist and the 250 for Cunning Stunts can come from any mix of the four kinds (PowerPyx). GTABase calls Under the Bridges the fastest, so knife flights only need to fill gaps.||

blocks.text: Wyman's
An Ultimate Edition side job: find wrecks of old cars, scan them and pay Wyman to rebuild them. It is not on the 100% checklist.
Rockstar lists Wyman's Classic Car Collection among the Ultimate Edition's extras: find abandoned classics and unfinished project cars and restore them.

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Collect the '67 Vapid Dominator from the Paradise garage in Watson Bay in Chapter 2 (Push Square)||
||$1,500 to Wyman for the Transgressor; $100 to register a car (Push Square)||

blocks.title: Scan the scrap
blocks.text: ||Find each scrap car and scan it with WAiNK so Wyman can collect the parts (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Pay for the work
blocks.text: ||Wyman then restores the car for a fee, paid through the BuckMe app on the phone; for the Transgressor it is $1,500 (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Keep it
blocks.text: ||Register the car at a Pay 'n' Spray for $100 or park it in one of your garages; otherwise it goes back to Wyman's yard (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Five cars
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx counts five cars, files them under Exploration and leaves them off its 100% checklist. Push Square names the Transgressor and the Riata, and had placed only the Transgressor's scraps.||

||The southern tip of Port Gellhorn, below Dirt Merchants (or Dunk's Robbery Tip): behind a wooden hut by a broken fence||

blocks.text: Key Lento
Push Square's walk through Key Lento collects seven hoops, a book swap, six readings, a watch and several scans in one go. Do it in Chapter 1 to catch Jason's house as well.

blocks.caption: Push Square's route, north-west to south-west
steps: ||The Rusty Anchor||
||Dolphin Dr, north to south||
||Jason's house, Peach Palm Dr||
||The bend of Peach Palm Dr||
||Sunset Dr and Laguna Dr||
||Pacific Dr||
||Surfside Dr||
||The south-west tip of Key Lento||

blocks.title: Start at The Rusty Anchor
blocks.text: ||In the north-west corner of Key Lento. Inside are a pool opponent, the Bang For Your Buck arcade game and, in the Captain's Log Room toilet stall, a NINE1NINE card (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Dolphin Dr, north end
blocks.text: ||Score the hoop in the garden of the north-easternmost house; the ball is by the entrance. Next door, in the party house, go upstairs: the Novak Laurent Alcazar watch and Pêche are in the first bedroom on the left, and a Los Santos Pounders card is in the toilet (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Dolphin Dr, heading south
blocks.text: ||Score the hoop in front of the garage of the house with swordfish decorations (the ball is inside the garage), read Killer Prom at the tortoise book swap two houses on, then score the hoop above a garage further south on the east side (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Jason's house
blocks.text: ||On Peach Palm Dr: score the hoop by his parking space, then read Orca, Lethal by Design, Body Copy, Ashes of Glory and Off the Hook inside, on the balcony and in the workshop below. The readings are Chapter 1 only (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Peach Palm Dr and Sunset Dr
blocks.text: ||Score the hoop above the garage of the house on the bend (the ball is beside the garage), then the one at the northernmost house on Sunset Dr (the ball is on the ground). Just south, the Badger R&D Tower is a WAiNK landmark with a Delights Dancers card at the top (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Laguna Dr and Pacific Dr
blocks.text: ||Where Sunset Dr meets Laguna Dr, the Christmas House is a WAiNK curiosity, decorated at night. The waterfront beach house has Trigger Happy on the corner of the dining table, and the back of the Plunge Masters dive centre is another curiosity (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Surfside Dr
blocks.text: ||Score the fenced hoop west of the Crastenburg Hotel Poolside Bar, scan the whale outside The Wonder Whale as a WAiNK sculpture, and score the hoop behind The Red Lotus next to Barnacle Beauties (Push Square).||

blocks.title: The tip of Key Lento
blocks.text: ||Finish at the Fatal Incursion Plaque by the water, a WAiNK sculpture (Push Square).||

blocks.title: Timing
items: ||The Jason's house readings are gone after Chapter 1 (Push Square, PowerPyx).||
||The Christmas House is only decorated at night (Push Square).||

chapters.title: 100% Activities
chapters.intro: Every activity that counts toward 100 percent: races, race challenges, drone trials, the two shooting ranges, golf, pool, basketball, video games, fishing, Bret's hunting decks, the animal log and the 80 challenges. Each page says how the activity opens, how to finish it or take gold, and what it pays.

blocks.text: Activities:
blocks.sub: Races, drones, ranges, sport, hunting and the challenges

blocks.text: This chapter walks through every pastime the game counts toward 100 percent completion: what opens it, how to finish it or take gold, and what it pays. ||Activities are about a fifth of the checklist, and every one of them can still be done after the story.||

blocks.caption: ||What the 100% checklist asks for from activities (PowerPyx and GTABase agree on every figure)||

blocks.title: The checklist appears after the story
blocks.text: ||The 100% Completion page, under Progress, Stats, only shows once the story is finished, but everything done before then still counts. PowerPyx says nothing on the list is missable, since all of it can be done in free roam after the story.||

blocks.title: Finding activities on the map
blocks.text: ||Most activities show as blue map icons once you are within about 100 metres. The map filter under Activities (the dumbbell icon) lists Racing, Top Fun Drones, Target Deck and the rest, which is the quickest way to see what is left nearby.||

blocks.title: Activities can be repeated
blocks.text: ||Story missions cannot be replayed, but VGC says racing, stunts, pool and the other minigame-style activities can, so a medal or a win can be retried as often as you like.||

blocks.title: Focus as a side reward
blocks.text: ||Several activities raise Focus, the stat behind slow-motion aiming, and Focus gains never wear off. PowerPyx names shooting range challenges (finished or quit), golf, pool and fishing; Push Square adds basketball.||

blocks.title: Trophies along the way
blocks.text: ||Master of None asks you to try each type of activity once. Others follow the activities in this chapter: Earn Cash, Not Kudos (20 different races won), Top Fun (a drone race won at every location), The Shootist (gold in every range challenge), Stick Fiddler (finish an arcade game), Baited My Tackle (beat Cal at fishing), Fair Game (a unique animal for Bret), One Last Thing (50 challenges) and A Long Road (100 percent).||

blocks.title: Cheats as rewards
blocks.text: ||After the story, many cheats unlock through activities: shooting range medals for the ammo cheats, 100 workouts for Body Armor, 100 fish for the Fisheye filter, 10 race wins at Gellhorn, the Mud Club and Boone for Repair Vehicle, and sets of challenges for the vehicle spawns. Using any cheat turns off trophies and saving for that session.||

blocks.title: What is not in the game
blocks.text: ||Rockstar producer Rob Nelson told VGC that darts did not make it in, and that basketball has no full games, only shooting around. Pool, he said, has proper physics, and weightlifting mimics the real thing rather than being a button press.||

blocks.title: Leave the challenges for last
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx and GTABase both suggest leaving the 80 challenges until the end: most of them happen on the way to everything else, and only 70 are needed.||
Races:
blocks.sub: Forty races at six venues

blocks.text: The Extended Look showed a circuit race, a night street race and an off-road race. ||The released game counts 40 unique races; winning any 30 of them is enough for the checklist, so the ten hardest can be skipped.||
On the map: 20 races

blocks.caption: ||The six race groups (PowerPyx)||
rows: ||Vice City: Salton 3, La Perle 2, Ocean Beach 2, Gloriana Key 2||
||Grayson, Redshaw's, Ranchers and Big Pine, two races each, in Lummox and Mariana counties||

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||An entry fee and, unless you bring a car of the right class, a rental fee for every race||
||Chapter 2 for the Mud Club, Chapter 3 for Hit 'N Run VC||
||30 for the checklist, 20 for the trophy||

blocks.title: Entering a race
blocks.text: ||Races appear as blue map icons within about 100 metres; the Racing filter under Activities lists them. Each costs an entry fee and a vehicle rental, but a win more than pays it back, and playing one race at a venue opens the next.||
blocks.frameAlt: Renting a dirt bike at the Mud Club: a Rent Sanchez ($250) prompt beside the bike's stats.

blocks.title: Hit 'N Run VC
blocks.text: ||After the Chapter 3 mission Dealer's Choice, Manuel adds you to a group chat and the side mission Join a Street Race appears in Salton. PowerPyx says you rent one of three cars there for $600 to $900, that the dearest has the best stats, and that first place pays $3,000. Yago, whom you meet at the start, then offers three more races of his own.||
blocks.frameAlt: Two sports cars racing down a city street at night, progress 5 percent, sixth of six.
blocks.frameCredit: Picture: GTABase (frame from Rockstar's An Extended Look)

blocks.title: Thrillbilly Mud Club
blocks.text: ||During the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Wyman tells you about the dirt races and Thrillbillies is marked. At the Mud Club, buy outfits at the souvenir shop by the entrance, then rent a Manchez or the faster Sanchez at Roostere's Rentals and race 13 riders. Losing does not fail it; first place pays $2,500. PowerPyx and VGC both warn that one collision can throw you off the bike.||
blocks.frameAlt: A car pulling into the Thrillbilly Mud Club grounds with the prompt to park up at the entrance.

blocks.title: Gellhorn International Raceway
blocks.text: ||Start with the Gellhorn Raceway Introduction, a supervised lap with Beau that GAMES.GG says must be finished inside one minute. It opens Keep It PG, a five-race amateur series, and playing those opens the rest of the races at the raceway.||

blocks.title: Ambrosia Raceway
blocks.text: ||Two demolition races at a track in north Ambrosia, marked once you are close. PC Gamer calls them easy money for weak drivers, because you win by default once every other car is wrecked, and says a rental costs a few hundred dollars.||
blocks.frameAlt: A roadside billboard for Ambrosia Raceway Park.

blocks.title: Boone Speedway and Animal Crackers
blocks.text: ||Boone Speedway, in the south-west corner of Hamlet, runs two elimination races. Animal Crackers has two races at each of four spots in Lummox and Mariana counties. PowerPyx gives no unlock step for either.||

blocks.title: Racing for the rewards
blocks.text: ||Twenty different wins earn Earn Cash, Not Kudos, and 30 meet the checklist. First places at Gellhorn, the Mud Club and Boone Speedway count toward the 10 that unlock the Repair Vehicle cheat. The Vehicle challenges Winning Streak (first place with a muscle car, a sports car and a supercar) and Rally Winner (three races in a row in one day at the Mud Club, Gellhorn and Boone, without quitting or restarting) are worth planning into the same sessions.||

items: ||Entry fees, rental prices and prize money for each race: only one guide, quoted in each race's Encyclopedia entry, gives them, and no second source confirms them yet.||
||Gellhorn has 11 races in PowerPyx's count and 10 in another guide's.||
||How the Animal Crackers and Boone Speedway races are first opened.||

blocks.text: Race challenges:
blocks.sub: Thirteen solo trials and stunt runs

blocks.text: ||Thirteen solo events, separate from the 40 races, each with bronze, silver and gold for a time or a score. Ten golds are enough for the checklist, so three can be left.||

blocks.caption: ||Medal targets, in the game's menu order (GAMES.GG; the figures match the Encyclopedia's entries)||
rows: ||Eastern North Kelly County, near Lake Leonida||
||Top of Mount Kalaga National Park, Lummox County||
Mud Club Air Time Stunt Run
||North Waning Sands, near Richard Barebone State Park||

blocks.title: Finding them
blocks.text: ||Like the races, race challenges show as blue map icons within about 100 metres and are listed under the Racing filter in Activities.||

blocks.title: Gellhorn needs its Introduction
blocks.text: ||Both Gellhorn trials open only after the raceway's Introduction, the supervised lap with Beau that has to be finished inside one minute. The Raceway Trial is run against a checkpoint timer; the Dragway Trial is a straight sprint, with gold at 11 seconds.||

blocks.title: Boone Speedway Trial
blocks.text: ||Bring a suitable car or rent one at the track for $400. Gold is 21 seconds.||

blocks.title: The six Mud Club events
blocks.text: ||Six of the thirteen are at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Frogswater: drag, hill climb, dirt track, oval and swamp run trials against the clock, and the Air Time Stunt Run, scored on time spent in the air, with gold at 1,600 points. Doing all six in one visit saves travel.||

blocks.title: The two stunt runs on bikes
blocks.text: ||The Hamlet BMX and Waning Sands Motocross stunt runs are scored, not timed: gold is 3,000 points at both. GAMES.GG says that at Waning Sands you must land tricks while passing the checkpoints, since riding cleanly without building a stunt score will not reach gold.||

blocks.title: Kalaga Cycling Trial
blocks.text: ||A downhill run from the top of Mount Kalaga National Park to the foot of the mountain, with gold at 1:05.||

items: ||Which vehicle each trial uses, and whether a rental is offered at every start. Only the Boone Speedway rental is reported.||

blocks.text: Top Fun:
blocks.sub: Forty-two time trials at fourteen sites

blocks.text: ||Top Fun runs drone time trials at 14 sites from Hamlet in the south to Millport in the north, three at each. All 42 are on the checklist.||
On the map: 5 drones

blocks.caption: ||Sites south to north, with each trial's par time (PowerPyx)||

blocks.title: Finding the sites
blocks.text: ||Sites show as blue map icons within about 100 metres and are filtered under Activities, Top Fun Drones; progress is under Progress, Activities, Top Fun Drones.||

blocks.title: Getting there
blocks.text: ||A taxi will fast travel you to every site except Dalton Island, which can only be reached by boat or aircraft.||

blocks.title: Beat par on the first two
blocks.text: ||The first two trials at each site must be flown under par; that opens the third, which only has to be finished in any time. That is 28 par times in all.||

blocks.title: Fly flat out
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx's only flying tip: hold the left stick forward the whole time for full speed, and do not touch anything.||

blocks.title: The trophy and the checklist
blocks.text: ||Winning one trial at every site earns Top Fun; the checklist wants all 42 completed.||

items: ||The entry fee and the prize for each trial: one guide gives them, quoted in the Encyclopedia, but no second source confirms them.||
||No clean picture of a drone trial was found.||

blocks.text: Griffin:
blocks.sub: Six timed courses in north-west Vice City

blocks.text: A shooting range was shown in the Extended Look. ||Griffin Shooting Range, in Balsero in north-west Vice City, has six timed courses with three tiers each. All 18 golds count toward the 42 the checklist wants.||
On the map: 7 shooting range challenges

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||$5 from the clerk in the range store; it marks the challenges on the map||
||Any missing type can be rented for $10, and rentals are good enough for gold||
||Lucia, who PowerPyx says runs faster and moves better||

blocks.title: How Griffin is scored
blocks.text: ||Every Griffin course is a timed run. A bullseye takes one second off, but PowerPyx says it is usually faster to hit each target quickly than to aim for perfect shots.||
blocks.frameAlt: Shooting down a villa-style course with 5 of 12 targets left and a time bonus shown.
blocks.frameCredit: Picture: GTABase (frame from Rockstar's An Extended Look)

blocks.title: 3-Point Range
blocks.text: ||Three weapon stations, each with a different weapon. Tiers: Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced. Speed beats accuracy.||

blocks.title: Hook Range
blocks.text: ||Shot on the move. Hit the top one of the five small red spinning targets first and work clockwise, and use slow motion for the last two red dots. Tiers: Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced.||

blocks.title: Loop Range
blocks.text: ||Much like Hook Range, again with small red spinning targets that are easiest in slow motion. Tiers: Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced.||

blocks.title: Maze Range
blocks.text: ||Another moving course like Hook and Loop. Tiers: Beginner, Intermediate and Master.||

blocks.title: Compound Range
blocks.text: ||A run through a building with pop-up targets and new weapons picked up on the way. The timer is lenient. On the minimap, the pink dot is the next weapon pickup and red dots are where targets appear. Tiers: Beginner, Intermediate and Master.||

blocks.title: Villa Range
blocks.text: ||Targets only appear as you get close, and on Intermediate and Master extra targets hide in the small side buildings. Plan one big loop through every house and practise it. Tiers: Beginner, Intermediate and Master.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia aiming a rifle down the villa course, 7 of 12 targets remaining.

blocks.title: Do not skip the hard ones
items: ||The checklist and The Shootist both need every gold at both ranges, 42 in all, so no course can be left out.||
||The bronze, silver and gold times for each Griffin tier. Only one guide publishes them (quoted in each course's Encyclopedia entry); PowerPyx and eGamers do not.||
||PowerPyx names the tiers Beginner, Intermediate and Master on the last three courses; another guide names them Intermediate, Advanced and Master.||

blocks.text: Rodgers Ranch:
blocks.sub: Six themed score courses near Port Gellhorn

blocks.text: ||Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range, on the north-east edge of Port Gellhorn in Kelly County, has six themed courses with four tiers each. You shoot from a fixed spot for points.||

blocks.caption: ||Weapons by tier (PowerPyx)||

blocks.title: How Rodgers Ranch is scored
blocks.text: ||Points build a multiplier, and a miss lowers it. Hit a target in the body once or twice before the head to build the multiplier quickly; headshots and the red weak points score the same. Buy the $5 waiver pass first, and rent any missing weapon for $10.||

blocks.title: Market Range
blocks.text: ||Pistol on every tier. Speed matters most; ignore the red bullseye.||

blocks.title: Zombie Range
blocks.text: ||Beginner, with the SMG, is the hardest tier. Shoot bodies to build the multiplier and do not miss; avoid SMG headshots, since a second bullet can pass through the destroyed head and reset the multiplier. With the shotgun, go for heads.||

blocks.title: Hunting Range
blocks.text: ||Headshot the small animals. On the large bears, land about four body shots before the weak point. Master allows no misses: every small animal in the head and three or four body shots per bear before the weak spot, to reach x5.||

blocks.title: Saloon Range
blocks.text: ||Beginner: shoot the first enemy in each arm once, then the hat and head of the rest. Intermediate: two body shots, then the head. Advanced: body then head on each enemy, no misses. Master: two body shots and a headshot on the first two enemies, headshots on the fast later ones, and a few body shots on the large armoured target before its head.||

blocks.title: Cops & Robbers Range
blocks.text: ||Sniper rifle throughout. Headshot every target on Beginner and Intermediate; on Advanced, every target except the cop. Reload in the gaps between targets.||

blocks.title: Alien Range
blocks.text: ||Two body shots, then the head, builds the multiplier fastest.||

blocks.title: What the medals unlock
blocks.text: ||Gold in every challenge at both ranges earns The Shootist. After the story, 25 bronze-or-better medals unlock the Max Ammo cheat, 25 silver-or-better Infinite Ammo and 25 golds No Reload. The Survival challenges Marksman (a medal at both ranges in one day) and Pro Marksman (gold on the Master tier of three different events in a row, without failing or quitting) also come from here.||

blocks.title: A quick Focus boost
blocks.text: ||Finishing or quitting any range challenge permanently raises Focus. PowerPyx says the Market Range Beginner challenge takes about five seconds and can be quit and restarted over and over.||

items: ||The score needed for each medal on each tier. Only one guide publishes them; PowerPyx and eGamers do not.||

blocks.text: Golf:
blocks.sub: Three mini golf courses and two full ones

blocks.text: Mini golf was shown in the Extended Look. ||The released game has three mini golf courses and two full-size golf challenges. Only mini golf counts: any two of the three courses played.||
On the map: 2 golf

blocks.caption: ||The five courses (PowerPyx)||
rows: ||Mount Hailes Club, Waning Sands, Leonard County||

blocks.title: Play two mini golf courses
blocks.text: ||A round at any two of King Gator, Frontier and Dino Golf meets the checklist. The two full-size courses do not count toward it.||
blocks.frameAlt: Cal Hampton holding a putter at an alligator-themed mini golf course while a woman putts behind him.

blocks.title: Pick King Gator and Frontier
blocks.text: ||The Sports challenges are all set at King Gator or Frontier, so playing those two covers the checklist and the challenges together.||

blocks.title: Golf Rookie
blocks.text: ||Play 18 holes at King Gator or Frontier in under 30 minutes, finishing 3 under par or better.||

blocks.title: Golf Pro
blocks.text: ||Play 18 holes at both King Gator and Frontier in one day, finishing at par or better on each.||

blocks.title: Double Hole In One
blocks.text: ||Two holes in one in a row in a single game at King Gator or Frontier.||

blocks.title: Tracking your rounds
blocks.text: ||Courses played and best scores are under Progress, Activities, Sports. Golf also raises Focus.||

items: ||Course fees, hole pars and the stroke targets for medals. One guide gives Dino Golf as free with per-hole medals; no second source confirms it.||

blocks.text: Pool:
blocks.sub: Seven players at seven bars

blocks.text: Pool was shown in the Extended Look, and Rockstar says it has proper physics. ||The world has 17 tables, but only seven have an opponent. Beating any five different opponents meets the checklist.||

blocks.caption: ||The seven opponents (PowerPyx)||
rows: ||The bar from the Chapter 1 pool scene; the opponent is not always there||
||East Millport, Lummox County, beside the Pay 'n' Spray||
||Off the highway through Buckskin Swamp, Kelly County||

blocks.title: Find an opponent
blocks.text: ||Seven of the 17 tables have a player waiting. Go to one of the venues above and challenge them at the table.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason lining up a shot at a pool table in a bar while Cal and other patrons watch.

blocks.title: Beat five different players
blocks.text: ||Each opponent counts once, so five wins at five venues are needed. Progress is under Progress, Activities, Sports, Pool.||

blocks.title: Two awkward venues
blocks.text: ||The Rusty Anchor player is not always there: come back later or reload. If you miss the Delights Cabaret player before the end of Chapter 2, they return once the club reopens later in the game.||

blocks.title: The pool challenges
blocks.text: ||Three Sports challenges: Pool Streak (win at 3 locations in one day without losing or quitting), Triple Bank (bank the cue ball off 3 rails before potting a ball) and 8-Ball Break (win by sinking the 8-ball on the break). Pool Streak is easiest on a tour of three nearby venues.||

blocks.title: Focus from pool
blocks.text: ||Playing pool raises Focus, and those gains are permanent.||

items: ||The stake and winnings at each table, and any reward for beating all seven. One guide reports a tattoo; no second source confirms it.||

blocks.text: Basketball:
blocks.sub: One score at a hundred hoops

blocks.text: Basketball was shown in the Extended Look; Rockstar says you shoot around rather than play full games. ||There are 100 hoops around Leonida. A score at 90 different hoops meets the checklist; scoring twice at the same hoop does not help.||

blocks.title: Shooting a basket
blocks.text: ||Pick up the ball with L1, aim with L2 and throw with R2. How hard the shot is depends on the angle and distance. A score marks that hoop as done.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason shooting a basketball at a hoop mounted under a stilt house.

blocks.title: Checking progress
blocks.text: ||Open the menu with the touch pad and go to Exploration, Basketball Hoops.||

blocks.title: Start at Key Lento
blocks.text: ||Push Square found seven hoops around Key Lento alone, one of them at the foot of the stairs at Jason's house, so the first few come early.||

blocks.title: Focus from every score
blocks.text: ||Scoring permanently raises Focus for Jason and Lucia.||

blocks.title: The basketball challenges
blocks.text: ||Four Sports challenges: Basketball Rookie (3 different hoops in a day), Basketball Streak (10 shots in a row within 2 minutes), Basketball Tour (a score in every county) and Basketball Pro (all 100 hoops).||

blocks.caption: ||Hoops located so far by Push Square (its guide is still being written)||
rows: ||In front of the north-easternmost house, near where Ocean Sound Rd leads north to Corsair Key; the ball is at the entrance||
||On Dolphin Dr, above the garage of a large house||
||Jason's house on Peach Palm Dr, at the bottom of the stairs||
||Above the garage of the house on the bend between Peach Palm Dr and Scuttlebutt Dr||
||At the house at the northern point of Sunset Dr, next to its awning||
||On Surfside Dr, west of the Crastenburg Hotel Poolside Bar, in a fenced court||
||Behind The Red Lotus on Surfside Dr, next to Barnacle Beauties||
||In the trailer park just north of the bargain store||
||In front of the main building of Avery Allen & Co. Aviation Services, east of Manifest Canyon||
||Behind the Peacock Estates mansion on Palladia Ln||

items: ||Where the other 90 hoops are. The Encyclopedia lists every hoop from a single guide; no second source covers the full set yet.||
||Rewards for reaching 10, 50 or 100 hoops: one guide lists clothing and tattoos; not confirmed elsewhere.||

blocks.text: Fitness:
blocks.sub: Strength, Cardio and the Fitness challenges

blocks.text: The gym was shown in the Extended Look. ||Workouts are not a line on the checklist by themselves, but six of the ten Fitness challenges, a trophy and a cheat depend on them.||
On the map: 9 fitness

blocks.title: Where to train
blocks.text: ||In Chapter 1 there are weights on the terrace of the first house. Fitness studios charge a membership fee; joining any gym completes the Fitness challenge Gym Member. Strength comes from weights; Cardio from treadmills and bikes, or from running, cycling and swimming outdoors.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason Duval lying on a bench, lifting a barbell.

blocks.title: Watch the workout windows
blocks.text: ||The Fitness app, opened from the phone, shows Workout Windows: periods in which a Strength or Cardio workout must be done, or that stat slips back. Focus never regresses.||

blocks.title: Finish every workout
blocks.text: ||An unfinished workout gives no gain, so stay until it is done.||

blocks.title: Protein, then sleep
blocks.text: ||A protein shake from the fridge at home, or a protein bar from a fitness studio, straight after a workout shortens the wait for the next window. Sleeping at the end of the day helps you recover.||

blocks.title: Train together
blocks.text: ||Later in the game the two leads can work out together at a studio; while you train one, the other finishes a workout too.||

blocks.title: The Fitness challenges
blocks.text: ||Gym Member, Foot Travel (5 miles on foot in a day), Pro Cyclist (15 miles in a day), Pro Swimmer (3 miles in a day), Balanced Workout (every type of gym equipment in one day), Strength Regime and Cardio Regime (Level 4 with both leads at once for 5 days running), Waning Sands Run, Tequesta Swim and Southwind Cycle.||

blocks.title: Body Armor and Personal Best
blocks.text: ||One hundred workouts unlock the Body Armor cheat after the story. The guides disagree on the Personal Best trophy: GAMES.GG says it needs maximum Strength on both leads, while Push Square says an Overweight body composition, with low muscle and maximum body fat, unlocks it.||

items: ||Gym names and membership prices. One guide names one studio and its fee; no second source confirms it.||

blocks.text: Video games:
blocks.sub: Three at home, one in the arcades

blocks.text: ||Four games can be played inside the game. Starting each one once, even if you quit straight away, meets the checklist.||

blocks.caption: ||The four games (PowerPyx)||
rows: ||The JoySystem console at the TV in your home||
||Chapter 1, then from Chapter 3 on; not in Chapter 2||
||Arcade machines around the world, such as the one outside Bargain World in Port Gellhorn||

blocks.title: Use the home console
blocks.text: ||Interact with the controller at the TV in your home and choose a game from the JoySystem console. Tenebrae Lux and Street Trash III are played once automatically during the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.||

blocks.title: Mind the Chapter 2 gap
blocks.text: ||The home console cannot be used during Chapter 2. It is back from Chapter 3 and stays available after the story.||

blocks.title: Find an arcade cabinet
blocks.text: ||Bang For Your Buck is only on arcade machines out in the world; PowerPyx points to the one outside the Bargain World clothing store in Port Gellhorn.||

blocks.title: Start each one
blocks.text: ||For the checklist it is enough to start each of the four games and exit.||

blocks.title: Stick Fiddler
blocks.text: ||Finishing every level of any one of the four earns Stick Fiddler.||
Fishing:
blocks.sub: Thirty-five species and Cal's challenges

blocks.text: Rockstar described fishing as catch and release before launch. ||Fishing has no line of its own on the checklist: Cal's fishing challenges count among the 100 optional tasks, fish count toward the animals studied, and four Survival challenges need a rod.||
On the map: 5 fishing spots

blocks.title: Get a rod
blocks.text: ||Fishing is open from the start. GTABase says a small pier west of Jason's house has a boat and several rods, so you need not wait for the fishing trip with Cal in the mission Recalibration.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason picking up a rod on the pier near his house, with a small saltwater lure selected.

blocks.title: Cast
blocks.text: ||Equip the rod from the weapon wheel (hold L1, Equipment tab). Use Focus to see fish as lighter patches in the water. Hold L2 to hold out the rod, then hold and release R2 to cast; a longer hold casts further.||

blocks.title: Hook and reel
blocks.text: ||Reel slowly with the right stick to attract a fish, press R2 when it bites, then push the left stick against the fish to tire it and turn the right stick to reel it in. With no bite, recast.||

blocks.title: Buy the right lure
blocks.text: ||Small Freshwater and Small Saltwater lures come free. GTABase lists Medium Freshwater at $45, Medium Saltwater at $56 and Large Saltwater at $125, sold at Ammu-Nation fishing-gear stores such as Chuck's Tackle & Shot in Key Lento; the Candy Cane lure is found on a desk in a house south-west of Ambrosia. Freshwater lures are for lakes and rivers, saltwater for docks, the coast and the sea.||
blocks.frameAlt: Buying fishing lures at the counter of Chuck's Tackle & Shot.

blocks.title: Cal's first challenge
blocks.text: ||After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts Jason to catch a stoplight parrotfish of more than 2 lb in Gambit Bay, Mariana County. After Chapter 1 the boat at Jason's house is gone, so take one from the docks near The Rusty Anchor, drop anchor at the spot, use the Small Saltwater lure and send Cal the photo with X/A. It raises Focus and earns Baited My Tackle; if it vanishes for a while during the story, it comes back.||

blocks.title: The fishing challenges
blocks.text: ||Survival challenges: Big Fish (a fish of 20 lb or more), Catch of the Day (3 fish with each type of lure in one day), Angler (4 species within 6 minutes) and Pro Angler (every species). After the story, 100 fish unlock the Fisheye screen filter.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason holding up a freshly caught fish by a jetty.

items: ||Lure prices differ between guides: GTABase gives $45, $56 and $125, while the figures in the Encyclopedia, from another guide, are lower.||
||Whether Cal sends further fishing challenges after the first: none of the sources read names one.||

blocks.text: Hunting:
blocks.sub: Fifteen target decks, for Jason only

blocks.text: Before launch Rockstar said hunting could earn money through a character who knows Jason. ||That is Bret Vogel. His questline is Jason's alone, and all 15 of his target decks are on the checklist.||
On the map: 7 hunting spots

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Jason, alone: the mission cannot start with Lucia along||
||The Killtelligence SM-69 from Bret; Push Square used a Wortham W-22 for small game||
||Something with room for small carcasses; Bret collects bears and boars himself||

blocks.title: Bret texts
blocks.text: ||In Chapter 2, after Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason and Veteran Hunted is marked in the far north of Lummox County.||

blocks.title: Ride out with Bret
blocks.text: ||Get in the truck. Bret hands over the unique Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle and drives to the woods.||

blocks.title: Follow the scent
blocks.text: ||Get out and use the scent view (L3 and R3). The trail turns yellow as you near the deer.||

blocks.title: Study, then shoot
blocks.text: ||Study the deer through a scope or binoculars by holding R1, then shoot it once in the heart or head to keep it pristine. More shots lower its quality.||
blocks.frameAlt: An antlered buck splashing through a misty swamp.

blocks.title: Load it and drive back
blocks.text: ||Pick up the carcass, put it in the back of Bret's truck when he pulls up, and drive back to the cabin.||

blocks.title: Process the deer
blocks.text: ||Carry the deer into the open building with the processing area. Bret pays $500 through BuckMe and starts marking more hunts in purple on the map.||

blocks.title: Work through the decks
blocks.text: ||Each completed deck brings a text about the next. Bret only takes animals in Pristine or Good condition, and Push Square notes that some animals spook if you get close, so a scope helps. Track the decks under Map, Activities, Target Deck, or Progress, Contacts, Bret Vogel.||

blocks.caption: ||The first three decks (Push Square)||
rows: ||Mount Kalaga National Park, Abandoned Concrete Plant||
||Leonida Wild White Tom (turkey), Eastern Spotted Skunk, Wild Boar||
||Adler Creek, Bonanza, Mount Kalaga National Park||
||West and East Buckskin Swamp, Pelican Valley||

blocks.title: Night and colour
blocks.text: ||Push Square saw the skunk only after about 8pm, in grassy areas, and Bret wants the white-feathered turkey. It found a boar by day in shaded forest, though boars are mostly nocturnal and can charge.||

blocks.title: Unique animals and the trophies
blocks.text: ||There are 8 unique animals. Hunting one for Bret earns Fair Game; killing all 8 is the Survival challenge Legendary Hunter. Hunting Spree asks for a boar, a rattlesnake and a panther within 15 minutes without taking damage.||

items: ||Decks 4 to 15: their animals and areas are not yet published by any source this guide uses.||
||What each deck pays. Only the first hunt's $500 is confirmed.||

blocks.text: Animals:
blocks.sub: The animal log, filled with binoculars

blocks.text: ||The game logs 255 animals. Studying any 100 meets the checklist, and no hunting or skinning is needed.||

blocks.caption: ||The animal log by group (PowerPyx)||

blocks.title: Use the binoculars
blocks.text: ||Equip the binoculars from the weapon wheel, zoom in with Up on the D-pad and hold R1 to study. A rifle scope works too, as Bret shows in Veteran Hunted.||

blocks.title: Every breed counts
blocks.text: ||Each breed of dog and cat is its own entry, so neighbourhood pets are an easy start.||

blocks.title: Fish count as you swim past
blocks.text: ||GTABase says fish count when you swim near them, so dives for other collections fill the log too.||

blocks.title: Check the log
blocks.text: ||Studied animals are under Progress, Vehicles / Animals.||

blocks.title: Two challenges on the way
blocks.text: ||The Survival challenge Zoologist asks for 20 species studied, and the Exploration challenge Encyclopedia for 100 animals, vehicles and weapons discovered.||

blocks.title: Study everything you meet
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx suggests studying each new animal as soon as you see it; doing so from the start fills the 100 without a special trip.||
Challenges:
blocks.sub: Combat, Criminal, Exploration and Fitness

blocks.text: ||Eighty challenges in eight groups of ten, all open from the start. Any 50 earn One Last Thing; 70 meet the checklist, so the ten slowest can be skipped.||

blocks.title: How to track them
blocks.text: ||Progress, Challenges lists all 80; a finished challenge shows a Completed tick in the bottom right corner when highlighted.||

blocks.title: Let them happen
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx says most challenges complete themselves while you work through the rest of the checklist, so look at what is left near the end and finish only enough to reach 70.||

blocks.title: Rewards: vehicle cheats
blocks.text: ||Five challenges in a group unlock one vehicle spawn cheat and all ten another; all 80 unlock the Hauners P-996 Lazer. The cheats can only be used after the story, and using one turns off trophies and saving.||

blocks.title: Plan the timed ones
blocks.text: ||Several need one day or a stopwatch: Stick Up Spree (2 stores in each county within 20 minutes), Road Trip (every town in one day) and Helipad Flyovers (41 helipads in 10 minutes) are worth a route planned in advance.||

blocks.sub: Shopping, Sports, Survival and Vehicle

blocks.text: ||The second half of the list. Sports and Survival overlap most with the activities in this chapter, so many will already be done.||

blocks.title: Sports while you play
blocks.text: ||All ten Sports challenges come from basketball, pool and mini golf; see those pages.||

blocks.title: Survival while you hunt and fish
blocks.text: ||Survival mixes fishing (Big Fish, Catch of the Day, Angler, Pro Angler), the ranges (Marksman, Pro Marksman), studying (Zoologist) and hunting (Alligator Kills, Hunting Spree, Legendary Hunter).||

blocks.title: Shopping with your earnings
blocks.text: ||Nest Egg needs $1,500,000 sitting in the BuckMe checking account, the biggest single ask in the group.||

blocks.title: Vehicle tricks
blocks.text: ||Rally Winner and Winning Streak fit into race sessions; Oceanarium Jump needs an aircraft and a parachute.||

blocks.text: The
||Every activity line on the 100% checklist, with the page in this chapter that covers it. Tick them off as you go.||

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: ||Remember the two story gates: the home console is off in Chapter 2, and Hit 'N Run VC opens only in Chapter 3. Everything else can wait until after the story.||

blocks.title: Quick lines first
blocks.text: ||The video games only need starting and exiting, and the animal log fills itself if you study each new animal as you meet it. The shooting ranges allow no gaps: all 42 golds are needed.||

blocks.title: Spare items
blocks.text: ||Some lines leave room to skip: 10 of the 40 races, 3 of the 13 race challenges, 2 of the 7 pool players, 1 mini golf course, 10 hoops and 10 challenges. Shooting range golds, drone trials, video games and Bret's decks must all be done.||

blocks.title: Fishing is not a line
blocks.text: ||There is no fishing requirement as such; Cal's fishing challenges count among the 100 optional tasks.||

cover.caption: Two sports cars racing down a city street at night, a frame from Rockstar's An Extended Lo

chapters.title: Vehicles & Police
chapters.intro: Standout cars and how to take them, the garages and shops that keep them, and the police side of completion: stars, cameras and getting away.

blocks.text: Cars, garages
blocks.sub: What this part of 100% asks of you, and the order to do it in

blocks.text: This chapter covers taking and keeping vehicles, the garages and shops that look after them, and the police who come after you while you do it. ||Only two vehicle items count toward the 100% checklist itself; the rest earn trophies or make the work easier.||

blocks.caption: ||What counts toward 100%, from PowerPyx's completion checklist||
rows: ||Scanning with the WAiNK app is enough; boats and aircraft count||
||PowerPyx says Randy's wish list gets you there on its own||
||The 280 one-off vehicles do not count toward the 200||

blocks.title: Scan everything you pass
blocks.text: ||Hold Up on the D-pad to raise the WAiNK app and press R1/RB at a vehicle to scan it. PowerPyx suggests standing by a busy road: pickups are common in the countryside and supercars in Vice City. Scanning is enough; you never have to drive the car.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason looking at his phone beside a black SUV in a Vice City car park

blocks.title: Get the Slim Jim
blocks.text: ||Moses hands it over in the Chapter 2 mission of the same name. It opens a locked door without breaking glass, so no window alarm.||
blocks.frameAlt: Lucia working a slim jim into the window seal of a police SUV

blocks.title: Register your first car with Moses
blocks.text: ||Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn registers and buys cars with no tracker from Chapter 2. GamesRadar+ and GTA BOOM both say the first registration there is free, so bring something good, such as the Penumbra FF on the Famous Cars page.||

blocks.title: Buy garages for more slots
blocks.text: ||Shortly after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver the Vice City Real Estate app arrives on your phone. Each garage slot lets you register one more vehicle.||

blocks.title: Get the Snap Gun
blocks.text: ||Yasmani gives it in Chapter 3 after the jewelry job in Dubious Provenance. It opens locked doors quietly, including garages that hide standout cars.||

blocks.title: Get the Key Cloner
blocks.text: ||It comes in Chapter 3 in Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal a Zorrusso for Randy. Keyless cars cannot be hot-wired without it, and Randy's wish list opens after this mission.||

blocks.title: Register tracked cars later
blocks.text: ||From early Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers cars with a standard tracker. GTA BOOM says cars with an advanced tracker need a later unlock from Randy.||

blocks.title: Pick up the trophies on the way
blocks.text: ||Stealing a tank, flying an airliner off a boarding bridge at VCIA and losing four stars with your partner each earn a trophy. The pages that follow show how.||

blocks.caption: ||The three theft tools and when they arrive||
rows: ||Locked car doors and trunks without an alarm; not a car with someone inside||
||Locked building and garage doors; the building alarm stays armed||

blocks.title: Cheats
items: ||PowerPyx says using a cheat switches off trophies and saving, so do not spawn vehicles on a file you are completing.||

blocks.text: Scan it,
blocks.sub: How every theft in this chapter starts

blocks.text: Rockstar showed a phone app that scans a car before you touch it. ||In the released game that scan tells you which tool you need, whether the car is alarmed, what tracker it carries and what it is worth.||

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||On your phone from the start; hold Up, then R1/RB||

blocks.title: Scan before you touch the door
blocks.text: ||Raise WAiNK and scan the car. The card names the model and lists access, security, tracker, sell value and the cost to register it. GTA BOOM advises scanning every car before trying a door.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason and Lucia by a dark sedan with a WAiNK card listing Key Cloner, Alarmed, Standard tracker, sell value and cost to register

blocks.title: Smash and hot-wire
blocks.text: ||Press interact at the door to see whether it is locked, alarmed or keyless. Smashing the window sets off any alarm; inside, hot-wiring takes a second or two of finding the sweet spot with the sticks.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason punching through the side window of a grey car in a street

blocks.title: Or use the Slim Jim
blocks.text: ||Pick Slim Jim at the door and hold the stick in the sweet spot until it pops. It avoids the window alarm and also opens the trunk quietly. It cannot be used on a car with someone sitting in it.||

blocks.title: Keyless cars need the Key Cloner
blocks.text: ||Keyless cars cannot be hot-wired. Choose Clone Key at the driver's door and tilt the right stick until the meter turns pink, then hold it there.||

blocks.title: Locked garages need the Snap Gun
blocks.text: ||With the Snap Gun equipped, a locked door offers Use Snap Gun: find the sweet spot with the left stick, then press the right trigger until the meter fills. The building alarm stays armed and can still be set off by kicking another door or by staff.||

blocks.title: Know the tracker
blocks.text: ||A standard tracker only stops you modifying the car until it is registered. An advanced tracker tells the police where you are once you slow down, so keep your speed up until you reach a buyer or a Pay 'n' Spray.||

blocks.title: Carjacking still works, with a fight
blocks.text: ||Drivers often resist: hammer the button to win, or you are knocked down and they drive off. Many Leonida drivers are armed.||

blocks.title: The pink sweet spot
blocks.text: ||Push Square says the Slim Jim, Clone Key and hot-wiring all have a pink sweet spot; finding it quickly buys you seconds to get away.||
Standout
blocks.sub: One-off cars, bikes and boats in fixed places

blocks.text: ||Standouts are customised one-off versions of ordinary models, each waiting in a fixed place. They fill the Progress database but do not count toward 100%.||
On the map: 1 special vehicles

blocks.title: What a standout is
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx counts 280 standout vehicles, described as unique vehicles in fixed locations. They are separate from the 277 base models, and none of them counts toward the 200 scans needed for 100%.||

blocks.title: Scanning or sitting in it records it
blocks.text: ||Push Square says a vehicle is discovered by getting inside it or scanning it. Check what you have under Progress, in the Vehicles section.||

blocks.title: Some are behind locked doors
blocks.text: ||The Tropic Dawn Youga in Key Lento sits inside a locked warehouse that needs the Snap Gun. Plan to sweep each area again after Chapter 3.||

blocks.title: Some wait at safehouses
blocks.text: ||GTA BOOM found a modified pickup in the garage of the Watson Bay Safehouse, beside crates on the side facing the main gate, and the game marked it as a standout. It warns that changing some of its unusual parts may mean they cannot be put back.||

blocks.title: The Girlypop set unlocks a filter
blocks.text: ||Discovering all 16 Girlypop standouts unlocks the Neon Jungle screen-filter cheat.||

blocks.title: Keeping one
blocks.text: ||A standout is registered like any other car, at Moses, a Pay 'n' Spray or a mod shop depending on its tracker, and it needs a free slot.||

blocks.caption: ||The 25 standout groups and how many each holds, from PowerPyx's Progress database||

items: ||Exact spots for most standouts. GTABase's interactive map shows 104 standout markers, but no allowed guide yet lists them in text; the next two pages give what is published.||
||Whether a standout respawns if it is destroyed or sold.||

blocks.text: Standouts
blocks.sub: Five near Jason's first home, four with a published route

blocks.text: ||Key Lento is where the story starts, and Push Square's walkthrough of the island gives the way to four standouts. A fifth is on GTABase's map without a written route.||

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Only for the Youga, inside a locked warehouse (Chapter 3)||

blocks.title: Bravado Tropic Dawn Youga
blocks.text: ||Go to the New Wave Custom & Repairs warehouse near where Dolphin Dr meets Sunbelt Hwy. Open the door with the Snap Gun and scan the van inside.||
blocks.frameAlt: A dark van with a tropical sunset mural parked inside a warehouse

blocks.title: Nagasaki Rudolph Tao
blocks.text: ||Head for Sunset Dr where it meets Laguna Dr and look for the house covered in Christmas decorations, lit up at night. Scan the Tao outside it.||
blocks.frameAlt: A green and red Christmas-livery boat reading Happy Holidays on a trailer

blocks.title: Vapid Shrimp and Save Shifter
blocks.text: ||Turn briefly off Pacific Dr to the Shrimp & Save store and scan the Shifter parked outside.||

blocks.title: Declasse Cousin Carlo's Akane
blocks.text: ||Cousin Carlo's is on Sunbelt Hwy, across the highway from the road down from Surfside Dr. Scan the Akane parked outside.||

blocks.title: Lure Predator Rainbow Ripple L20S
blocks.text: ||GTABase's map places this centre-console boat in the Key Lento area. Its picture shows it in the shallows off a rocky shore; no allowed guide gives the exact spot in text.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason on a rocky shore at sunset looking at a blue centre-console boat in the shallows

blocks.title: Do it in one loop
blocks.text: ||The four with routes sit along Sunset Dr, Dolphin Dr, Pacific Dr and Sunbelt Hwy. Scan the three outdoor ones early and come back for the Youga once you have the Snap Gun.||
Standouts
blocks.sub: Every standout the Encyclopedia has an entry for, outside Key Lento

blocks.text: ||These tables list the standouts GTABase's map files under each area, each linked to its Encyclopedia entry. The map gives an area, not a street, so search the area with WAiNK ready.||

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Some standouts are locked away or keyless (Chapter 3)||

blocks.title: Vice City first
blocks.text: ||Vice City holds the most standouts in the Encyclopedia. The Purple Drank Emerus, for one, sits on a dirt lot among shipping containers with the Downtown towers behind.||
blocks.frameAlt: A purple hypercar on a dirt lot among shipping containers, Downtown towers behind

blocks.title: Capri: the police Coquette
blocks.text: ||The Enforcer Coquette, in City of Capri police livery, stands on a plinth outside the police department.||
blocks.frameAlt: A white police-livery sports car on a plinth outside a police department, Jason leaning on it

blocks.title: Ambrosia holds the most
blocks.text: ||Sixteen of the Encyclopedia's standouts are filed under Ambrosia, more than any other area; give it a full sweep.||

blocks.title: Boats and aircraft count too
blocks.text: ||Several standouts are airboats, jet skis or a helicopter, so check the water and the airfields as well as the roads.||
