blocks.text: Famous cars
blocks.sub: A film car, a garage of supercars and a restored classic

blocks.text: ||Three published hunts for cars you can keep: the Penumbra FF on Vespucci Island, the Starfish Island mansion garage, and Wyman's restored classic for Ultimate Edition owners.||

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||None; Slim Jim or Snap Gun help||

blocks.text: The Penumbra FF

blocks.title: Find the garage on Vespucci Island
blocks.text: ||GamesRadar+ places the green film car, a nod to Brian O'Conner's Eclipse, in a locked house garage on Vespucci Island, one of the Rialto Islands west of Vice Beach. GTA BOOM names it the '97 Penumbra FF, with a HAD YOU plate.||

blocks.title: Get in without the alarm
blocks.text: ||GTA BOOM says to Slim Jim the main garage door from outside, which sets nothing off; breaking the door on the right triggers the security alarm. GamesRadar+ says that alarm can be switched off quickly on the wall to your left as you go in. Go at night to cut down witnesses. The Slim Jim only arrives in the mission Moses, but GamesRadar+ says neither tool is needed if you switch the alarm off fast.||

blocks.title: Take the car
blocks.text: ||Smash the window or use the Slim Jim, hot-wire it and drive out. Smashing the window sets off the car alarm.||

blocks.title: Register it free with Moses
blocks.text: ||Take it to Moses as your first car and the registration is free; otherwise GTA BOOM puts it at $6,750. Registering means a respray, which loses the green paint. Vice Vinyl restores it for $185, or $540 with $355 of repairs.||
The Starfish Island garage

blocks.title: Find the driveway
blocks.text: ||Cross onto Starfish Island from Waxman Island and follow the road to the turnaround at the north-east end. The garage, green walls and a pale floor, is beside the driveway with a small oval loop next to the big waterfront house.||
blocks.frameAlt: An aerial view across the water toward Starfish Island with the Vice City skyline behind

blocks.title: Scan all four cars
blocks.text: ||Each showed Key Cloner access and Alarmed security when GTA BOOM scanned it. The fourth, a yellow spotted car, is parked by the front steps, not in the garage. Check your own quotes; these were theirs.||

blocks.title: Register the Dubsta first
blocks.text: ||The Dubsta has a standard tracker, so once Chapter 3 lets Pay 'n' Sprays take them, clear any search and choose Register, not Sell.||

blocks.title: The other three wait for Randy
blocks.text: ||The advanced-tracker cars need Randy's later unlock: deliver the '64 Declasse Mamba GT and wait for his call. Even with a cloned key, slowing down can give your position away.||

blocks.caption: ||GTA BOOM's WAiNK quotes for the Starfish Island cars||

blocks.text: Wyman's classic (Ultimate Edition)

blocks.title: Collect the '67 Dominator
blocks.text: ||In Chapter 2, collect the '67 Vapid Dominator from the Paradise garage in Watson Bay. Wyman then texts you about the '67 Transgressor and a quest appears under Exploration.||
blocks.frameAlt: A lifted blue and yellow off-road muscle car with roof lights outside a workshop

blocks.title: Scan the three Transgressor wrecks
blocks.text: ||Scan all three with WAiNK, then pay Wyman his $1,500 fee through BuckMe. Register the finished car at a Pay 'n' Spray for $100 or park it in a garage, or it goes back to his salvage yard.||

blocks.caption: ||Where Push Square found the '67 Transgressor wrecks, all in Port Gellhorn||
rows: ||Trailer park on Tanglewood Ln, just north of Sarena's Bargain Store, on a paved patch in a field of pigs||
||Gellhorn Ave, north-west of Wasteland Off-Road: down the right side of the blue house with sunflowers to the garage at the back||
||The southern tip of Port Gellhorn below Dirt Merchants, behind a wooden hut by a broken fence||

items: ||Where Wyman's other four cars are: Push Square's guide is unfinished and lists only the Transgressor and, without a location, the Riata.||

blocks.text: The wish
blocks.sub: High-end cars stolen to order

blocks.text: ||Randy's wish list opens after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. He buys high-end cars with advanced trackers and pays more for a car in good condition. Push Square has published routes for 10 of the cars; they follow in its order.||
On the map: 9 randy's wish list

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Every car on the list is keyless||
||Most have trackers; keep your speed up||

blocks.caption: ||How the list works, and where the guides differ||
rows: ||PowerPyx: a garage with a green RK icon in west Vice City. Push Square: talk to him at Leonida Auto World for hints||
||PowerPyx: 16 sports cars, plus the Zorrusso delivered in the story. Push Square: 22||
||PowerPyx: around $35,000 or more for a sports car in perfect condition||
||Touch Pad, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List; scan cars with WAiNK to check||

blocks.title: Bravado Banshee
blocks.text: ||Parked outside the Sweetbay Inn on East Buckley Dr in Capri, around 3 a.m. Clone the key and drive it to Randy.||
blocks.frameAlt: A blue sports car with white racing stripes parked on a city street

blocks.title: Pegassi Tempesta
blocks.text: ||On NE 3rd St, Vice City, around 1 p.m. as a random event: the owner is beating a repossession man. Threaten the owner, release the car from the tow truck and take it.||

blocks.title: Pegassi Infernus
blocks.text: ||On the 7th level of the Crosstown Police Station car park on NW 9th St. Slip in when an officer opens the gate, clone the key, drive to the top floor and leave by the stunt jump. It has a tracker, so keep your speed up.||

blocks.title: Pegassi Vitello
blocks.text: ||A villa on Flamingo Pkwy, Waning Sands, east of Belville. Hop the fence and plant explosives on the gate without setting them off. The car is in the garage nearest the house on the right; clone it, then blow the gate to leave.||

blocks.title: Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire
blocks.text: ||The M7 junkyard east of Boone Speedway, off Galerina St in Hamlet. Open the entrance gates first, keep low along the right-hand side and clone the car parked at the back.||
blocks.frameAlt: A red muscle car driving beside a truck

blocks.title: Mamba GT
blocks.text: ||Added during the mission Dale Mamba. Behind a guarded Leaf Links mansion in Vice Beach; its key is in a bowl on a table behind the sofa in the main building past the pool. The Snap Gun opens the doors. It is tracked and hard to handle.||
blocks.frameAlt: An aerial view of Leaf Links with a waterway, a bridge and green spaces

blocks.title: Ascot Paragon
blocks.text: ||Outside The Banana Hole main bar on Shore Dr, Ocean Beach, around 6 p.m. Clone it and drive fast; it is tracked.||

blocks.title: Piccia Furia
blocks.text: ||A mansion on Palladia Ln, Peacock Estates, Peacock Bay. Skip the gate: take the path on the left over the hedge and through the garage door on the right, between the water and a garage building. Clone it, open the shutters and leave by the gates.||
blocks.frameAlt: A dark red supercar seen side-on on a street

blocks.title: Pegassi Toros
blocks.text: ||Outside the entrance to Pegassi Residences on Bayside Dr, Tequesta Retreat, around 6:30 p.m. There is some security; clone it and get away quickly.||

blocks.title: Pfister Growler
blocks.text: ||A multi-storey car park on Fig St, Ocean Beach, around 5 p.m. Clone it and drive it back.||

blocks.title: Before you deliver
items: ||PowerPyx says Randy pays more for a car in good condition, so avoid crashes on the way back.||
||The Infernus is inside a police station car park: being seen there brings the police straight away.||
||The other wish-list cars and their routes: Push Square's guide is unfinished, and no other allowed source lists them.||
||What Randy pays for each car.||

blocks.text: Jets, tanks
blocks.sub: The two biggest thefts in Leonida, and two trophies

blocks.text: ||Mile Zero Air Station holds jets, tanks and helicopters; Vice City International holds the airliners. Both bring a high wanted level the moment you are inside.||

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Not your personal vehicle: it will be wrecked and left inside the base||
||From Ammu-Nation, for the gunfire at the checkpoints||

blocks.title: Drive to Mile Zero
blocks.text: ||The base is on Goose Key in the far south-west of the map. From the starting area in Key Lento head west along the main road, through Abismo Key and Southwind.||

blocks.title: Jump the fence
blocks.text: ||Weave through the lightly manned concrete checkpoints on the southern access road and hit the dirt mound at speed by the south-east corner. It is the Mile Zero Air Station Southeast stunt jump, and it lands you on the runway.||

blocks.title: Take a jet
blocks.text: ||Drive straight down the runway to the jets parked by the hangars, jump into a cockpit, light the afterburner and take off; then retract the landing gear.||

blocks.title: Or take a tank
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx says the tanks are in the south of the base. Climb in and shoot some enemies until the Challenging Tank trophy unlocks.||

blocks.title: Steal an airliner at VCIA
blocks.text: ||For Catch Me If You Can the plane must be at a departure gate on a boarding bridge; planes out on the airfield do not count. PowerPyx suggests gates E3 and E4: drive through an airfield fence and climb the stairs by the boarding bridge.||
blocks.frameAlt: A white flyUS jumbo jet at a jet bridge on the VCIA apron

blocks.title: Fly a kilometre away
blocks.text: ||The trophy is delayed until you are 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport.||
blocks.frameAlt: A small plane banking over the VCIA runways with the Vice City skyline ahead

blocks.title: Smaller planes at VCIA
blocks.text: ||PC Gamer also lists a Lapwing Streamer 216-C, service vehicles and a Declasse D7700 utility truck at the airport.||
blocks.frameAlt: A white and red twin-prop plane parked by a hangar, the city skyline behind

blocks.caption: ||What PC Gamer found parked at Mile Zero||

blocks.title: Expect the military
items: ||GamesRadar+ says a jet theft brings at least five stars, and military jets with homing missiles follow; its writer was shot down before the first bridge. Fly low and take evasive action.||
||PC Gamer says stealing a passenger jet or an APC brings the highest star levels.||

blocks.text: Garages
blocks.sub: Every place you can keep a car

blocks.text: Before launch Rockstar's Rob Nelson said a stolen car could be registered and kept in a garage. ||In the released game garages are the only property you can buy, and each slot lets you register one more vehicle.||
On the map: 1 safehouses
On the map: 13 garages

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Arrives shortly after Daily Driver, late in Chapter 2||

blocks.title: Wait for the app
blocks.text: ||Shortly after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses, a notification says Vice City Real Estate has been installed on your phone.||

blocks.title: Buy from your phone
blocks.text: ||Press Up for the phone, open Vice City Real Estate and buy. Each of the eight garages for sale has one parking spot.||

blocks.title: Buy all eight for the trophy
blocks.text: ||Owning all eight earns Little Boxes. The four story garages do not count toward it.||

blocks.title: Four more come with the story
blocks.text: ||Port Gellhorn Station, Thompson Court, NE 15th Street and Pegassi Residences are given by missions, with up to three spots each.||

blocks.title: Know the limit
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx counts 18 slots at most: 16 in garages plus your two personal vehicles, parked where you left them. When the slots are full, sell a car to make room.||

blocks.title: Edition and membership garages
blocks.text: ||GTABase lists three more outside PowerPyx's twelve: Paradise Garage in Watson Bay for the Ultimate Edition, Shore Court Garage on Shore Drive as a pre-order bonus, and the GTA+ Crosstown Garage from Chapter 3 with an active GTA+ membership.||

blocks.title: Register ten for On the Spot
blocks.text: ||Registering 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app earns On the Spot, so you need ten parking spots first. PowerPyx suggests cheap cars and bikes to keep the fees down.||

blocks.title: Call a car to you
blocks.text: ||Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and pick a car. The fee depends on the distance and the car's condition, and the car appears nearby, marked on the minimap.||

blocks.caption: ||The eight garages for sale: prices and spots from PowerPyx, areas from GTABase||
||The four story garages||

items: ||Where exactly each garage is: GTABase gives areas only. Push Square spells two of them Mitchel Auto Center and Vela Rota Drive Garage.||

blocks.text: Mod shops
blocks.sub: Fourteen shops, each best at one kind of vehicle

blocks.text: Before launch Rockstar said no single shop does everything. ||PowerPyx lists 14, two of them for Ultimate Edition owners only.||
On the map: 14 mod shops

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||A car with a standard tracker cannot be modified until it is registered||
||Paint, parts and repairs are paid from your bank account||

blocks.title: Find them on the map
blocks.text: ||Mod shops show as orange car icons once the map is uncovered. Map, then Vehicles (the car icon), then Mod Shops lists them with a counter in the bottom left.||

blocks.title: Look for the blue wrench
blocks.text: ||Every shop sells generic upgrades. A blue wrench beside a shop in the index means it specialises in the vehicle you are driving and has exclusive parts for it.||

blocks.title: Paint and liveries
blocks.text: ||In the shop menu press R1/RB to reach Cosmetics. Press Right on the D-pad to change paint type; each shop offers different finishes. Liveries, decals and plates are on the same tab.||

blocks.title: Repairs
blocks.text: ||Pull into a mod shop or Pay 'n' Spray and repair is the first option. Gas stations fix only minor damage, at a higher price.||

blocks.title: Register here too
blocks.text: ||Push Square says vehicles can be registered at a Pay 'n' Spray or a mod shop, as long as you have a free parking spot.||

blocks.title: The Ultimate Edition shops
blocks.text: Rockstar lists One-Eyed Willie's, known for hand-painted off-road liveries, and Rideout Customs, for detailed interiors and rims, among the Ultimate Edition benefits. ||PowerPyx puts One-Eyed Willie's in Leonard County and Rideout Customs in Vice-Dale County.||
blocks.frameAlt: A bright green off-road truck with its hood up in a workshop, people working around it

blocks.title: Spending challenges
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx lists Shopping challenges for five modifications, for spending over $20,000 in one visit and for over $125,000 at mod shops in all. Treat Yo Self wants $100,000 across every kind of shop, and car mods are among the quickest ways to spend it.||

blocks.caption: ||PowerPyx's 14 mod shops, county by county||
rows: ||Lowriders: rims and interiors for classic sedans||

blocks.caption: Looking down into a car's red interior, from Rockstar's Rideout Customs pictures.

items: ||Street addresses for the mod shops: PowerPyx gives counties only.||
||A full list of modification categories.||

blocks.text: Pay 'n' Spray
blocks.sub: Repair, respray, register and sell

blocks.text: ||There are 19 Pay 'n' Sprays. They repair and repaint, and later in the story they register and buy cars as well.||
On the map: 19 paint shops

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: Register a car with no tracker
Register a car with a standard tracker
Register a car with an advanced tracker
||A free parking slot, and the fee, which rises with the car's value||

blocks.title: Unlock them
blocks.text: ||Pay 'n' Sprays open with the Chapter 1 mission Just a Scratch. Open the Index, then Vehicles, then Pay 'n' Sprays to list the ones you have found, nearest first, and set a waypoint.||

blocks.title: Your first respray
blocks.text: ||In Unwanted Attention you climb into the Hamlet impound lot through a gap in the top of the wall, take a car off a tow truck, lose the police and take it to the Pay 'n' Spray for Brian.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason with a rifle on his back by a tall white wall topped with barbed wire

blocks.title: Repair
blocks.text: ||Repair is the first option when you drive in. The cost depends on the damage.||
blocks.frameAlt: A damaged sports car in the Pay 'n' Spray Balsero with Repair selected

blocks.title: Respray to lose vehicle Heat
blocks.text: ||A respray removes the vehicle's Heat. You cannot drive in while the police can see you, shown by solid stars, and PowerPyx says to leave the immediate search area first.||
blocks.frameAlt: The Respray menu with a red sports car and five colour swatches, priced $100

blocks.title: Register a car
blocks.text: ||Drive in, choose Register to swap the plates and pay the fee. With Moses, choose Respray and Register in his garage. You need a free stored-vehicle slot.||

blocks.title: Sell a car
blocks.text: ||Inside the lot press R1/RB for the Stored Vehicles tab to sell registered or garaged cars; the money goes to BuckMe. A dedicated fence may pay more for an exotic car.||
blocks.frameAlt: The Pay 'n' Spray Grayson Stored Vehicles list with a blue sports car and its sale price

blocks.title: Mind the cooldown at Moses
blocks.text: ||VGC says Moses pays $1,000 to $5,000 a car and then needs a cooldown before he buys another; sleeping at a safehouse ends it.||

blocks.title: Use it to end a chase
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx's escape trophies count a trip through a Pay 'n' Spray as getting away, the same as leaving the red heat zone.||

blocks.caption: ||PowerPyx's 19 Pay 'n' Spray locations||

items: ||The price of a respray beyond the $100 shown in GamesRadar+'s picture.||
||Exactly when the advanced-tracker unlock arrives: only GTA BOOM describes it.||

blocks.text: Wanted levels,
blocks.sub: What brings the police and what the stars are telling you

blocks.text: Six stars are back. ||Launch guides agree the police only come when a crime is reported, and that six stars can never be shaken.||

blocks.title: A crime has to be reported
blocks.text: ||Police respond to reports: a witness, a robbery alarm, or a stolen car with an advanced tracker. Serious crimes raise the level.||

blocks.title: Read the stars
blocks.text: ||GTABase describes five looks; the table below gives them. Flashing stars appear both when police are on their way and after they lose sight of you.||

blocks.title: Read the icons under them
blocks.text: ||Red icons under the stars show what the police know: your appearance, outfit, vehicle, a visible weapon, your partner and CCTV footage. Each has its own fix; see Losing the Stars.||

blocks.title: Killing police makes it worse
blocks.text: ||Killing officers brings a more aggressive response and pushes your criminal profile toward Violent. Once K9 units are called they track you relentlessly.||
blocks.frameAlt: A black armoured police truck marked SWAT with its door open under a bridge

blocks.title: Four stars
blocks.text: ||Robbing a bank vault always gives four stars. PowerPyx says helicopters join from four stars up.||

blocks.title: Five stars
blocks.text: ||PC Gamer says five stars sends a tank, and that trespassing at the airport to steal a passenger jet, or hijacking an APC at the military base, brings the highest levels. GamesRadar+ found the wanted-level cheat will not go past five.||

blocks.title: Six stars
blocks.text: ||Only mass destruction and loss of life bring six. PC Gamer managed it by stealing a tank and blowing up other tanks; GamesRadar+ after a chase of more than 15 minutes. Police and military then never stop, and the only way out is to die.||

blocks.caption: ||The star looks, as GTABase names them||
rows: ||Cops responding: on their way to the scene||
||Suspect unknown: they know a crime happened, not who did it||
||Visual lost: keep moving and they eventually clear||
||Heat: you got away, but they still hold the clues shown by the icons||

items: ||What arrives at one, two and three stars: none of the allowed launch guides read sets it out level by level.||

blocks.text: Cameras
blocks.sub: How CCTV feeds the police, and how to stop it

blocks.text: Rockstar's Extended Look shows a camera icon among the clues the police hold. ||Launch guides explain it: footage can identify you once the police arrive, unless you destroy it first.||

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Put on before the crime, so the camera never sees your face||

blocks.title: The camera icon
blocks.text: ||If a CCTV camera records a crime, a camera icon appears under your stars, and the police can use the footage to identify you when they arrive.||

blocks.title: On site or in the cloud
blocks.text: ||Ordinary CCTV is stored on site and can be destroyed. Cloud CCTV, shown by its own icon, cannot be removed, and an alarm eventually goes off.||

blocks.title: Watch for the signs
blocks.text: ||Shops with cameras can carry a warning sign by the door, like the one beside this back entrance.||
blocks.frameAlt: Jason at a back door next to a sign reading Warning, we operate cameras in this area, with the Use Snap Gun prompt

blocks.title: Cover up first
blocks.text: ||Wear a mask or face covering before the crime, not during the getaway, and avoid or take out cameras where you can.||

blocks.title: Get into the back room
blocks.text: ||The Snap Gun opens a back door silently, which PC Gamer calls the best way to reach the office and switch the alarm off completely.||

blocks.title: Destroy the footage
blocks.text: ||In the back room, interact with the security system to destroy the footage and disable the alarm. VGC says this delays the police response; PowerPyx makes it part of robbing a jewelry store undetected for Sneakthief.||

blocks.title: Before it uploads
blocks.text: ||GTA BOOM says footage can be held locally or in the cloud, and that destroying cameras before it uploads keeps it from becoming a lasting description.||

blocks.title: If it went to the cloud
blocks.text: ||You cannot destroy cloud footage, so clear the other icons and leave the area.||

items: ||Traffic or number-plate cameras on the roads: none of the allowed launch guides read describes them in the released game.||
||Whether shooting a camera after it has seen you removes the icon.||

blocks.text: Losing
blocks.sub: Break contact first, then clear the clues

blocks.text: ||GTA BOOM puts it in two parts: break the chase, then remove what the police know so the search does not lock back on. Nothing clears while they can see you.||

blocks.title: Break line of sight
blocks.text: ||Put a wall, a tunnel or a corner between you and them, then keep going until you are outside the red search zone and the lighter ring around it. Police are not on the minimap; use Focus to find them.||

blocks.title: Hide
blocks.text: ||Ladders, unlocked doors, woods and bushes in the country, or a parked car all work. In a stopped car hold Circle/B to duck; PowerPyx says you can also duck while driving past police.||

blocks.title: Watch your map arrow
blocks.text: ||The arrow changes to show whether you are hidden or the police know where you are.||

blocks.title: Clear the clues
blocks.text: ||Each icon has its own fix, in the table below. Do it out of sight.||

blocks.title: Respray or swap the car
blocks.text: ||Abandon the car, put it in a garage, respray it at a Pay 'n' Spray once you are clear of the immediate search area, or steal another.||

blocks.title: Split up
blocks.text: ||Sending Jason and Lucia different ways removes the partner icon, but if either is caught you are both Busted.||

blocks.title: Shoot at the helicopter
blocks.text: ||Police helicopters stop chasing when you shoot at them.||

blocks.title: Let the zone cool
blocks.text: ||Stay out of the red zone and commit no new crimes there; residual heat cools on its own. Going back too early, or still matching a clue, brings the stars back.||

blocks.caption: ||Each clue and how to clear it||
rows: ||Change accessories (hat, glasses, mask) or visit a barber||
||A full change; spare outfits can be kept in the car trunk. A hat or jacket alone does not count||
||Ditch it, garage it or respray it||
||Holster the pistol or stow the longarm||
||Destroy on-site footage; cloud footage cannot be removed||

blocks.title: What a failed escape costs
items: ||GTABase says being Wasted or Busted loses the cash you carry, a small BuckMe fee, weapons you do not own and most likely your stash bags. Bank your cash at an ATM first.||
||Six stars cannot be lost at all.||

blocks.text: Escape
blocks.sub: Where the guides go when the police come

blocks.text: ||Few guides name places, but the ones that do agree on a fast bike, the railway lines and anywhere a police car cannot follow.||

blocks.caption: What you need
rows: ||Cuts through traffic and leaves the search area quickly||
A spare outfit in the trunk

blocks.caption: ||A summary of the order the launch guides give, not a rule from the game.||
steps: Break line of sight
Leave the red zone and its lighter ring
Swap or respray the vehicle
Clear outfit, face, weapon and partner clues
Stay away until the zone clears

blocks.title: Bike through traffic
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx's easiest escape after a robbery: a fast sports bike through traffic, then switch to another vehicle to become anonymous. It uses the same method for the bank-vault trophy.||

blocks.title: Follow the railway
blocks.text: ||With a helicopter overhead, follow the train tracks, for example in south-west Vice City or north of Ambrosia. Police cars do not usually spawn by tracks in the wilderness.||

blocks.title: The tunnel north of Ambrosia
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx names the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, in Kelly County, as the easiest place to lose four stars with your partner for Hot Together. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red zone.||

blocks.title: Beat spike strips and dogs
blocks.text: ||Vary your route and avoid long straights, and take to the water or the air where strips cannot follow. Keep moving, and put distance or a vehicle between you and police dogs.||

blocks.title: Go on foot through the gaps
blocks.text: ||Vaulting and climbing open more paths on foot. Press X/A at the right moment to slide over a car bonnet, and shoot some door and gate controls to open them.||

blocks.title: Drive through a Pay 'n' Spray
blocks.text: ||Once you are outside the immediate search area, a respray clears the car, and PowerPyx's escape trophies count it as getting away.||

blocks.title: A rooftop exit in Crosstown
blocks.text: ||Push Square's route out of the Crosstown Police Station car park is its top-floor stunt jump, with a tracked car and the police below.||

items: ||Named hiding places in Vice City itself: none of the allowed guides read lists any.||
||How long each level takes to clear.||

blocks.text: Vehicles and police:
blocks.sub: Tick each one off as you go

blocks.text: ||Only the first two lines count toward the 100% checklist. The rest are trophies or collections in the Progress menu, listed so nothing is missed.||

items.item: Vehicles registered to Scooter Bros (trophy, not 100%)
Airliner flown from a VCIA gate (trophy)
Four stars lost with your partner (trophy)
Jewelry store robbed unseen, footage destroyed (trophy)

blocks.title: Figures that may change
items: ||The counts are PowerPyx's from launch week and may change with patches.||

chapters.title: Robbery Planner
chapters.intro: Banks, big banks, pawn shops, jewelry stores, payday loans, ATMs, stick-ups and gang sites: what each needs, what helps, the steps, the way out and what it pays, with every target planned as a run on the map.

blocks.text: Robbery

||Every kind of robbery in one place, in the same order: what opens it, what you need, what helps, the steps, the best way out, what it pays and how hot it gets. Each page ends with what the guides do not say yet.||

blocks.caption: ||When each kind of robbery opens, and how many the map shows.||
rows: Small banks open after the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), about halfway through the story.
Vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe), which Yasmani offers after the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown, near the end of Chapter 4.
Pawn shops become robberies after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, about halfway through Chapter 2.
Jewelry stores open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, about halfway through Chapter 3.
Payday loan stores open after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which gives the Dye Pack Jammer.
Power Up Gaming says ATM robbery opens after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs through Yasmani's ATM Jobs, which GTABase lists as his first side mission.
Stick-ups are open from Chapter 1; most enterable stores can be robbed, even without a map icon.
Gang operations are available from Chapter 1; 19 are marked by the story.

blocks.title: Plan a run on the map
blocks.text: ||Each page links to the map, which numbers every target of that kind in a short order from where you are. The lines are straight, between approximate pins, not roads.||

blocks.title: Before any robbery
items: ||Leave the red heat area, not just the flashing search area, to lose the police.||
||Marked bills must go through a fence before you can spend them.||

blocks.text: Small
||The 14 small branches: a cash drawer and a safe, no vault.||
Plan this run on the map (14 stops)

||Small banks open after the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), about halfway through the story. Credit Check hands over the Dye Pack Jammer, without which fences will not take bank cash.||

blocks.title: What you need
blocks.text: ||The Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check, so the marked bills can be fenced. A mask worn from the Items tab before entering; Credit Check supplies masks. Explosives or the Snap Gun for a locked back door, and explosives for a safe if you have no code. Credit Check walkthroughs use the partner as getaway driver, waiting in the driver's seat.||

blocks.title: Recommended
blocks.text: ||Park facing the road outside the branch so the getaway starts fast. Threaten the guards immediately, before they draw; if one draws, disarm him, shoot his knees or use melee. Rob without hurting anyone and disable alarms and tapes to keep the Professional criminal profile. Plan the escape before going in, because the police response to a bank is huge once they are called. Opening a safe with explosives is faster but damages part of the cash inside, according to GAMES.GG's store guide.||
Step by step

blocks.title: Mask up, partner drives
blocks.text: ||Put the mask on and leave your partner in the driver's seat.||

blocks.title: Hold up the guards, then the teller
blocks.text: ||Enter, threaten the guards first, then threaten the teller.||

blocks.title: Get the safe code
blocks.text: ||Ask the teller for the safe code (aim and choose Safe Code?); the teller also opens the cash drawer.||

blocks.title: Empty the cash drawers
blocks.text: ||Loot every cash drawer behind the counter.||

blocks.title: Open the back door
blocks.text: ||Open the back door with the Snap Gun, an explosive or by breaking it.||

blocks.title: Open the safe
blocks.text: ||Enter the code on the back-room safe or plant an explosive on it; a code can also be on a note in the back office or on a downed guard.||

blocks.title: Get to the car and split up
blocks.text: ||Run to the car, which your partner brings round, and split up after the job to divide the police.||
Best route and getaway

blocks.title: Stay out of the search zone
blocks.text: ||Keep clear of the police search zone around the bank you just robbed, and split up with your partner after the job.||

blocks.title: Break line of sight
blocks.text: ||Break line of sight, get out of the red search area and the lighter ring around it, then change outfit and vehicle.||

blocks.caption: ||What small banks pay, how hot they get and whether they come back.||
rows: ||Small banks pay about $5,000 to $45,000 per robbery depending on the branch. All bank cash is marked bills that a fence takes only once you have the Dye Pack Jammer; Yasmani in Little Cuba pays the most for them.||

||No allowed launch guide states the wanted level for a small bank; PowerPyx and HappyGamer give star counts only for vaults. In Credit Check the third branch's alarm goes off and security comes from the back; PowerPyx says leave at once because the police are already coming.||
||No allowed guide says whether or when a robbed bank can be robbed again.||

blocks.caption: ||Place by place, where a guide says something about it.||

blocks.text: Big
||The 8 large banks: a security van delivery opens the vault.||
Plan this run on the map (8 stops)
||Vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe), which Yasmani offers after the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown, near the end of Chapter 4.||

blocks.title: What you need
blocks.text: ||That's Where The Money Is... completed. Optional: Yasmani sells security van tips for $10,000 each once his two Payday Loans robberies are done. Explosives to blow the doorway at the back of the bank. A partner, because a vault holds more than one character's bags; hand a full bag over to them.||

blocks.title: Recommended
blocks.text: ||A fast motorcycle for weaving through traffic during the four-star chase. A spare outfit or a hat and glasses to change into once out of sight. Tail the van from a distance; the driver notices if you get too close.||
Step by step

blocks.title: Find a security van
blocks.text: ||Find a security van: follow one you come across, wait at a bank until one arrives, or buy a $10,000 tip from Yasmani, which marks vans with a purple icon.||

blocks.title: Tail it to a bank
blocks.text: ||Tail the van to a bank and park nearby.||

blocks.title: Follow the guard in
blocks.text: ||Follow the guard inside on foot; the vault stays open only while he delivers the briefcase of cash.||

blocks.title: Hold up the lobby
blocks.text: ||Mask up, draw your gun and hold up the lobby.||

blocks.title: Blow the vault doorway
blocks.text: ||Blow the doorway at the back with explosives and deal with the guards inside the vault.||

blocks.title: Fill the bags
blocks.text: ||Fill the bags from the cart of marked bills, hand a full bag to your partner or switch to them.||

blocks.title: Take the drawer and safe too
blocks.text: ||GAMES.GG then takes the cash drawer and safe too, which the bank needs for the checklist.||

blocks.title: Escape and sell the bills
blocks.text: ||Escape with four stars, change vehicle and outfit, then sell the bills to Yasmani.||
Best route and getaway

blocks.title: Partner drives, you shoot
blocks.text: ||Let your partner drive while you shoot at pursuers.||

blocks.title: A fast bike through traffic
blocks.text: ||Use a fast motorcycle through traffic; a highway works in a fast car but expect roadblocks.||

blocks.title: Swap vehicles out of sight
blocks.text: ||Once out of sight, pull into a parking lot or covered garage, swap vehicles and change your look.||

blocks.title: The train tunnel north of Ambrosia
blocks.text: ||PowerPyx's easiest escape for four stars is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you.||

blocks.title: Leave the red heat zone
blocks.text: ||Leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area; a Pay 'n' Spray also helps.||

blocks.title: The first vault: Ocean Beach
blocks.text: ||GAMES.GG says Yasmani's introductory vault job is the medium-security Lombank in Ocean Beach, with a dock nearby for a boat escape.||

blocks.caption: ||What big banks pay, how hot they get and whether they come back.||
rows: ||Vaults pay about $65,000 to $205,000 per robbery; the two top Lombanks pay $135,000 to $205,000. GTABase says a full haul in the first vault job is worth around $80,000. KeenGamer says a successful run typically brings $100,000 to $200,000 in a few minutes. The money is marked bills; Yasmani pays the best rate.||

||Robbing a vault gives four wanted stars at once and the police open fire straight away. PowerPyx says the Hot Together trophy (lose four stars with your partner) usually pops during vault robberies, and only once you leave the red heat zone.||
||Vaults can be robbed again after the story by finding more vans or buying more tips; no allowed guide gives a cooldown per bank.||

blocks.caption: ||Place by place, where a guide says something about it.||
rows: ||PowerPyx lists the vault take as $100,000 to $150,000; the cash drawer, safe and vault all count for the job. GAMES.GG gives this bank a high security rating on its map card.||
||PowerPyx lists the vault take as $65,000 to $110,000; the cash drawer, safe and vault all count for the job. GAMES.GG gives this bank a high security rating on its map card.||

||PowerPyx lists the vault take as $135,000 to $205,000; the cash drawer, safe and vault all count for the job. GAMES.GG gives this bank a high security rating on its map card. HappyGamer suggests a fast motorbike through traffic for the Downtown banks.||

||PowerPyx lists the vault take as $100,000 to $150,000; the cash drawer, safe and vault all count for the job. GAMES.GG gives this bank a high security rating on its map card. HappyGamer suggests a fast motorbike through traffic for the Downtown banks.||

||Two large Lombanks are in Ocean Beach: PowerPyx lists one at $135,000 to $205,000 and the other at $75,000 to $135,000. GAMES.GG rates the $135,000 to $205,000 Lombank as high security and the second one as medium. HappyGamer suggests a fast boat from the nearby docks for Ocean Beach, which avoids bridge roadblocks.||

||PowerPyx lists the vault take as $75,000 to $135,000; the cash drawer, safe and vault all count for the job. GAMES.GG gives this bank a high security rating on its map card. HappyGamer suggests a fast boat from the nearby docks for Ocean Beach, which avoids bridge roadblocks.||

||PowerPyx lists the vault take as $95,000 to $140,000; the cash drawer, safe and vault all count for the job. GAMES.GG gives this bank a high security rating on its map card. HappyGamer suggests a fast boat from the nearby docks for Ocean Beach, which avoids bridge roadblocks.||

blocks.text: Pawn
||Pawn shops: a counter, a back office and a safe.||
Plan this run on the map (13 stops)
||Pawn shops become robberies after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, about halfway through Chapter 2. The optional Coffee Break job Hit Avery Pawn in Port Gellhorn introduces them.||

blocks.title: What you need
blocks.text: ||A gun and a mask; from Chapter 3, the Snap Gun for back doors and sticky bombs for safes.||

blocks.title: Recommended
blocks.text: ||Scout first: pawn shops are heavily secured and many can be entered from the back, where security can be switched off and footage destroyed. Keep your partner on the staff; clerks are quick to shoot. Do not kill or knock out the employees before getting the code, or you cannot learn it from them. Body armour for a loud attempt and a vehicle with trunk space for bags and spare clothes.||
Step by step

blocks.title: Get the safe code
blocks.text: ||Draw your gun on the staff and threaten them repeatedly until Safe Code? appears.||

blocks.title: Smash the cases
blocks.text: ||Smash the display cases and collect the jewelry; breaking glass alone does not pick it up.||

blocks.title: Clear the back office
blocks.text: ||Go through the staff door to the back office, deal with the employee there, destroy the CCTV footage and turn off the alarm.||

blocks.title: Open the safe
blocks.text: ||Open the safe with the code or a sticky bomb; the shop only counts as done once the safe is looted.||

blocks.title: Lose the police and fence
blocks.text: ||Leave, lose the police and fence the jewelry.||
Best route and getaway

blocks.title: A fast bike or off-road
blocks.text: ||A fast sports bike through traffic, or going off-road.||

blocks.title: Change outfit and car
blocks.text: ||Change outfit and respray or swap the car after the chase.||

blocks.caption: ||What pawn shops pay, how hot they get and whether they come back.||
rows: ||PowerPyx gives $1,000 to $12,000 per pawn shop, depending on the shop. Paid as jewelry and goods that must be sold to a fence; Yasmani pays the best rate for jewelry.||
||Breaking a case or a door calls the police with two stars. Pawn shop robberies bring a higher wanted level than a grocery store.||
||GTABase says robbed stores need time to restock, so an early repeat pays less; no time is given.||

blocks.caption: ||Place by place, where a guide says something about it.||
rows: ||Port Gellhorn shop from Hit Avery Pawn; the safe is beside the desk in the back office, reached through the staff-only door behind the counter. The safe code is random: PowerPyx's game showed 6499 and VGC's showed 3156. CCTV footage and the alarm switch are in the back office. PowerPyx lists the take as $1,000 to $10,000; GTABase says the mission bag can be stashed at Dunk's trailer in Port Gellhorn.||

items: ||Guard counts, camera and safe positions for the other 14 pawn shops.||
||Exact wanted level for a quiet pawn shop robbery where no glass is broken.||
||Restock time.||

blocks.text: Jewelry
||Smash and grabs: glass cases, a back room and an alarm.||
Plan this run on the map (23 stops)
||Jewelry stores open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, about halfway through Chapter 3.||

blocks.title: What you need
blocks.text: ||The Snap Gun, given by Yasmani after the first delivery in Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, opens alarmed back doors silently. Sticky bombs as a fallback for safes.||

blocks.title: Recommended
blocks.text: ||Use the back door with the Snap Gun; kicking it sets off the alarm. Open the back-office safe first, then take display jewelry if time allows. Your partner keeps the shop floor under control while you work.||
Step by step

blocks.title: In through the back door
blocks.text: ||Snap Gun the back door and quietly deal with staff or security in the back.||

blocks.title: Kill the cameras and alarm
blocks.text: ||Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm at the panel.||

blocks.title: Find the code, open the safe
blocks.text: ||Find the code (often a note in the office or on a desk) or threaten someone for it, and open the safe.||

blocks.title: Leave quietly or go loud
blocks.text: ||Leave quietly, or go to the front, smash the cases and empty the drawers.||

blocks.title: Escape and sell
blocks.text: ||Escape and sell to Yasmani.||
Best route and getaway

blocks.title: Quiet means no chase
blocks.text: ||Done quietly you can leave without a chase; otherwise lose the police, change clothes and respray the car.||

blocks.caption: ||What jewelry stores pay, how hot they get and whether they come back.||
rows: ||PowerPyx gives $1,000 to $25,000 per store; KeenGamer says $10,000 to $25,000 is typical. GAMES.GG shows an upper take of $35,000 for Covgari, Blanc & Giroux and Royal Jewelry, where PowerPyx lists $14,000 to $25,000. Paid as jewelry for a fence; Yasmani pays the highest rate.||

||A quiet run with the alarm off and footage destroyed can end with no chase; the Sneakthief trophy is for robbing a jewelry store undetected. Jewelry stores bring a higher wanted level than a grocery store.||
||Robbed jewelry stores restock over time, so you can rob others while waiting; no time is given.||

blocks.caption: ||Place by place, where a guide says something about it.||
rows: ||PowerPyx's easiest store for Sneakthief: Snap Gun the back door, find the safe code note in the back room, destroy footage and disable the alarm. In Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs the safe is in the north-east corner of the central room, code 6815.||
||Back door opens with the Snap Gun; footage and security are in the small back office and the safe is halfway down the long back hallway, code 0104 in Yasmani's job.||
||GAMES.GG names Covgari as one of three stores for the Retail Therapy trophy chain, with Blanc & Giroux and Royal Jewelry.||
||GAMES.GG names Royal Jewelry as one of three stores for the Retail Therapy trophy chain; PowerPyx says the three north Vice City jewelry stores are the easiest spot for it.||

||Guard counts and safe positions per store.||
||Restock time.||
||Whether the map marker 'Bolongiru' is Blanc & Giroux.||

blocks.text: Payday
||Payday loan stores: guards, a locked door and cash drawers.||
Plan this run on the map (7 stops)
||Payday loan stores open after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which gives the Dye Pack Jammer. Yasmani's Payday Loans Jobs is his second side mission, after Yasmani's ATM Jobs.||

blocks.title: What you need
blocks.text: ||The Dye Pack Jammer to fence the marked bills.||

blocks.title: Recommended
blocks.text: ||Watch for staff hitting the panic alarm; payday stores have a lot of security.||
Step by step

blocks.title: Hold up the teller
blocks.text: ||Aim at the teller and wait for the cash to be put on the counter, then take it.||

blocks.title: Empty the back safe
blocks.text: ||Go into the back room and empty the safe; the store only counts with both.||

blocks.title: Lose your wanted level
blocks.text: ||Lose your wanted level before going to a fence.||
Best route and getaway

blocks.title: Escape before selling
blocks.text: ||Escape the police before selling.||

blocks.caption: ||What payday loans pay, how hot they get and whether they come back.||
rows: ||PowerPyx gives $2,000 to $25,000 per store; Little Cuba is the best at $15,000 to $25,000. Paid as marked bills; Yasmani pays high.||
||No allowed guide gives the wanted level for an open-world payday loan robbery.||
||PowerPyx's Bad Luck, I Guess trophy has you rob the Little Cuba store from the Prologue again, so story locations can be robbed later in free roam.||

blocks.caption: ||Place by place, where a guide says something about it.||
rows: ||$15,000 to $25,000, the best payday store. For Bad Luck, I Guess (after Credit Check, Lucia alone): take out the guards, break through the door and take the cash from three drawers, then escape on foot; the trophy fails if you leave by vehicle.||
||PowerPyx lists Quick Buck in Hamlet at $5,000 to $15,000.||
||PowerPyx lists Quick Buck in La Perle at $5,000 to $15,000.||
||Kelly County, $2,000 to $10,000, the lowest payday take.||

items: ||Wanted level for a payday loan robbery.||
||Guards, cameras and safe positions per store.||
||Restock time.||

blocks.text: ATMs
||Tearing out ATMs with a winch, and opening security trucks.||
Plan this run on the map (12 stops)

||Power Up Gaming says ATM robbery opens after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs through Yasmani's ATM Jobs, which GTABase lists as his first side mission. Power Up Gaming says roaming security trucks need no unlock; vault vans come with That's Where The Money Is.||

blocks.title: What you need
blocks.text: ||A winch from a Mod Shop, fitted to a vehicle you own. Sticky bombs for a truck's rear doors, and a vehicle to block it. The Dye Pack Jammer to sell the marked bills.||

blocks.title: Recommended
blocks.text: ||Rob a truck near a bank, where they drive around.||
Step by step

blocks.title: Winch the ATM out
blocks.text: ||ATM: find a towable one on the map (only some are), reverse up so the winch hooks on, then drive forward to tear it out.||

blocks.title: Break it open
blocks.text: ||ATM: escape, then break it open by driving or with an explosive, and shoot the cash cases.||

blocks.title: Rob a security truck
blocks.text: ||Truck: follow it, block it, plant a sticky bomb on the rear doors, detonate and shoot the security cases.||
Best route and getaway

blocks.title: Fast vehicle, then respray
blocks.text: ||Use a fast vehicle, leave the red heat area, respray at a Pay 'n' Spray and change outfit.||

blocks.caption: ||What atms and vans pay, how hot they get and whether they come back.||
rows: ||No allowed guide gives an amount for an ATM or a security truck. Both pay marked bills; Yasmani gives the best rate.||

||Pulling an ATM from the wall alerts the police; Power Up Gaming expects them as soon as it comes out. A Classic Blitz Play (rob an armoured truck and escape) unlocks only after you leave the red heat zone.||
||No allowed guide says whether ATMs or trucks respawn.||

items: ||Cash held by an ATM or a truck.||
||Whether ATMs need a story unlock (sources disagree).||
||Wanted level for each.||
||Respawn time.||

blocks.text: Stick-ups
||Convenience, liquor and fast food stores: the quickest robbery.||
||Stick-ups are open from Chapter 1; most enterable stores can be robbed, even without a map icon.||

blocks.title: What you need
blocks.text: ||A gun you can draw and something to cover your face.||

blocks.title: Recommended
blocks.text: ||Park a getaway vehicle outside and keep a spare outfit in its trunk. Check the exits first; One Stop Liquor in Key Lento has a back door, but forcing it alerts the owner.||
Step by step

blocks.title: Mask up and aim
blocks.text: ||Mask up, go in and aim at the cashier.||

blocks.title: Take the register
blocks.text: ||Demand the register or open it yourself and take every stack.||

blocks.title: Open the back safe (optional)
blocks.text: ||Optionally open a back-room safe with a code from staff or a note, or force it.||

blocks.title: Leave and lose the heat
blocks.text: ||Leave, change outfit and get out of the heat zone.||
Best route and getaway

blocks.title: Change, respray, leave the zone
blocks.text: ||Change outfit, swap the car or respray it at a Pay 'n' Spray for $200, and leave the red heat zone even after the stars clear.||

blocks.caption: ||What stick-ups pay, how hot they get and whether they come back.||
rows: ||PowerPyx gives $100 to $3,000 at liquor stores; GAMES.GG says a register usually holds a couple of hundred dollars. Paid as pocket cash.||
||GAMES.GG says a store robbery brings one or two stars; VGC says the response to a grocery store is low.||
||GAMES.GG says the same shop cannot be robbed back to back and may stay closed for a while; robbing again inside its active heat area brings faster police.||

items: ||How long a robbed store stays closed.||
||Which stores have a back-room safe.||

blocks.text: Gang
||Raiding gang sites for cash, drugs and weapons.||
Plan this run on the map (21 stops)
||Gang operations are available from Chapter 1; 19 are marked by the story.||

blocks.title: What you need
blocks.text: ||Armour, healing and a rifle; sticky bombs for safes from Chapter 3.||

blocks.title: Recommended
blocks.text: ||Use Focus to spot guards and explosives before going in. Prioritise sites with cocaine, which sells for far more than weed.||
Step by step

blocks.title: Check the valuables
blocks.text: ||Hover over the icon to see the key valuables, usually a unique weapon, a watch and a safe.||

blocks.title: Pick loud or stealth
blocks.text: ||Choose a loud fight or a stealth approach and clear the guards.||

blocks.title: Take the valuables and safe
blocks.text: ||Take every key valuable and open the safe with a code found on site, a sticky bomb or Break Open.||

blocks.title: Store the bags and escape
blocks.text: ||Store bags in your vehicle, escape and fence narcotics.||
Best route and getaway

blocks.title: Leave by boat
blocks.text: ||Several sites are on water; leaving by boat is the usual escape.||

blocks.caption: ||What gang operations pay, how hot they get and whether they come back.||
rows: ||Pay varies by site; GTA BOOM found about $3,000 cash at Watson Bay and about $14,400 from one Apollo Aggregates haul.||
||PowerPyx leaves Kingpin Bowling with two stars; no guide gives a general rule.||
||Sites restock over time, but unique weapons do not come back.||

blocks.caption: ||Place by place, where a guide says something about it.||
rows: ||Island in Wetman Bay, high security; land by boat on the south shore, avoid swimming (alligators). About six or seven Kingfishers; the W-22 is on the kitchen counter, $500 is under the floorboards. Escape from the north dock by boat or seaplane.||
||Kolts site in Port Gellhorn; the safe office has several armed Kolts. An office on the east side holds three safe codes, including Kingpin Bowling and La Cascara Motel.||
||Safe is on the top floor; gang members on most floors; code is at Brooks Boatworks.||
||Kingpin Bowling: watch in the south-east office, shotgun on the north-east pool table, safe code 0300. Leave by the alley with two stars; the trophy pops after you escape.||
